        authorizedAccounts[msg.sender] = 1;
        emit AddAuthorization(msg.sender);

        safeEngine = ISAFEEngineLike(safeEngine_);
        collateralType = collateralType_;

        discount = WAD;
        lowerCollateralMedianDeviation = WAD;
        upperCollateralMedianDeviation = WAD;
        lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;
        upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;
        minSystemCoinMedianDeviation = WAD;

        totalAuctionLength = uint48(3 days);
        minimumBid = 1;
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-ether-accepted");
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/fallback-not-allowed");
    }

    // --- Authorization ---
    function addAuthorization(address account) external isAuthorized {
        authorizedAccounts[account] = 1;
        emit AddAuthorization(account);
    }

    function removeAuthorization(address account) external isAuthorized {
        authorizedAccounts[account] = 0;
        emit RemoveAuthorization(account);
    }

    // --- Admin ---
    function modifyParameters(bytes32 parameter, address data) external isAuthorized {
        if (parameter == bytes32("oracleRelayer")) {
            oracleRelayer = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("collateralFSM")) {
            (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(data, bytes4(0x20531bc9));
            require(ok && source != address(0), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/collateral-fsm-invalid-value");
            collateralFSM = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("systemCoinOracle")) {
            systemCoinOracle = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("liquidationEngine")) {
            liquidationEngine = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("safeEngine")) {
            safeEngine = ISAFEEngineLike(data);
        } else {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/modify-unrecognized-param");
        }

        emit ModifyParameters(parameter, data);
    }

    function modifyParameters(bytes32 parameter, uint256 data) external isAuthorized {
        if (parameter == bytes32("discount")) {
            require(data >= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-discount-offered");
            discount = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("lowerCollateralMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-lower-collateral-median-deviation");
            lowerCollateralMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("upperCollateralMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-upper-collateral-median-deviation");
            upperCollateralMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-lower-system-coin-median-deviation");
            lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            require(data <= WAD, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-upper-system-coin-median-deviation");
            upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("minSystemCoinMedianDeviation")) {
            minSystemCoinMedianDeviation = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("minimumBid")) {
            minimumBid = data;
        } else if (parameter == bytes32("totalAuctionLength")) {
            totalAuctionLength = uint48(data);
        } else {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/modify-unrecognized-param");
        }

        emit ModifyParameters(parameter, data);
    }

    // --- Auction Lifecycle ---
    function startAuction(
        address forgoneCollateralReceiver_,
        address auctionIncomeRecipient_,
        uint256 amountToSell_,
        uint256 amountToRaise_,
        uint256 initialBid_
    ) external isAuthorized returns (uint256 id) {
        require(amountToSell_ > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/no-collateral-for-sale");
        require(amountToRaise_ > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/null-amount-to-raise");

        id = _add(auctionsStarted, 1);
        auctionsStarted = id;

        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        auction.raisedAmount = initialBid_;
        auction.soldAmount = 0;
        auction.amountToSell = amountToSell_;
        auction.amountToRaise = amountToRaise_;
        auction.auctionDeadline = uint48(_add(block.timestamp, uint256(totalAuctionLength)));
        auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver = forgoneCollateralReceiver_;
        auction.auctionIncomeRecipient = auctionIncomeRecipient_;

        _transferCollateral(msg.sender, address(this), amountToSell_);

        emit StartAuction(
            id,
            initialBid_,
            amountToSell_,
            amountToRaise_,
            discount,
            forgoneCollateralReceiver_,
            auctionIncomeRecipient_,
            uint256(auction.auctionDeadline)
        );
    }

    function buyCollateral(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        require(auction.amountToSell > 0 && auction.amountToRaise > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/inexistent-auction");
        require(systemCoinsToBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");

        (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) = getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
        require(collateralBought > 0 && adjustedBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (adjustedBid > remainingToRaise) adjustedBid = remainingToRaise;
        require(adjustedBid > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/null-adjusted-bid");
        if (adjustedBid < minimumBid && remainingToRaise > minimumBid) {
            revert("FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/invalid-bid");
        }

        auction.raisedAmount = _add(auction.raisedAmount, adjustedBid);
        auction.soldAmount = _add(auction.soldAmount, collateralBought);

        _transferInternalCoins(msg.sender, auction.auctionIncomeRecipient, adjustedBid);
        _transferCollateral(address(this), msg.sender, collateralBought);

        emit BuyCollateral(id, adjustedBid, collateralBought);

        _removeCoinsFromAuction(adjustedBid);

        if (auction.raisedAmount >= auction.amountToRaise || auction.soldAmount >= auction.amountToSell) {
            uint256 leftover = remainingAmountToSell(id);
            if (leftover > 0) {
                _transferCollateral(address(this), auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver, leftover);
            }

            emit SettleAuction(id, leftover);
            delete bids[id];
        }
    }

    function settleAuction(uint256 id) external {
        id;
        // Deliberately left as a no-op for interface compatibility.
    }

    function terminateAuctionPrematurely(uint256 id) external isAuthorized {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        require(auction.amountToSell > 0 && auction.amountToRaise > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/inexistent-auction");

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;
        uint256 leftoverCollateral = remainingAmountToSell(id);

        if (remainingToRaise > 0) {
            _removeCoinsFromAuction(remainingToRaise);
        }
        if (leftoverCollateral > 0) {
            _transferCollateral(address(this), auction.forgoneCollateralReceiver, leftoverCollateral);
        }

        emit TerminateAuctionPrematurely(id, msg.sender, leftoverCollateral);
        delete bids[id];
    }

    // --- Bid Accessors ---
    function bidAmount(uint256) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return 0;
    }

    function raisedAmount(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return bids[id].raisedAmount;
    }

    function amountToRaise(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return bids[id].amountToRaise;
    }

    function remainingAmountToSell(uint256 id) public view returns (uint256) {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        if (auction.soldAmount >= auction.amountToSell) return 0;
        return _sub(auction.amountToSell, auction.soldAmount);
    }

    function forgoneCollateralReceiver(uint256 id) external view returns (address) {
        return bids[id].forgoneCollateralReceiver;
    }

    // --- Pricing / Oracle Logic ---
    function getCollateralMedianPrice() public view returns (uint256 collateralMedianPrice) {
        (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(collateralFSM, bytes4(0x20531bc9));
        if (!ok || source == address(0)) return 0;

        (uint256 value, bool valid) = _tryGetResultWithValidity(source);
        if (!valid) return 0;
        return value;
    }

    function getSystemCoinMarketPrice() public view returns (uint256) {
        (address source, bool ok) = _tryReadAddress(systemCoinOracle, bytes4(0x09fa15b5));
        if (!ok || source == address(0)) return 0;

        (uint256 value, bool valid) = _tryGetResultWithValidity(source);
        if (!valid) return 0;

        return _mul(value, 10 ** 9);
    }

    function getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(uint256 redemptionPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 minDev = minSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : minSystemCoinMedianDeviation;
        uint256 lowerDev = lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : lowerSystemCoinMedianDeviation;

        uint256 a = _wmul(redemptionPrice, minDev);
        uint256 b = _wmul(redemptionPrice, lowerDev);

        return _max(a, b);
    }

    function getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(uint256 redemptionPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 minDev = minSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : minSystemCoinMedianDeviation;
        uint256 upperDev = upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : upperSystemCoinMedianDeviation;

        uint256 a = _wmul(redemptionPrice, minDev);
        uint256 b = _wmul(redemptionPrice, upperDev);

        return _min(a, b);
    }

    function getFinalBaseCollateralPrice(uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) public view returns (uint256) {
        if (collateralMedianPrice == 0 || finalSystemCoinPrice == 0) return 0;

        uint256 lowColl = _wmul(collateralMedianPrice, lowerCollateralMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : lowerCollateralMedianDeviation);
        uint256 highColl = _wmul(collateralMedianPrice, upperCollateralMedianDeviation == 0 ? WAD : upperCollateralMedianDeviation);
        uint256 boundedCollateral = _bound(collateralMedianPrice, lowColl, highColl);

        uint256 floorCoin = getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(finalSystemCoinPrice);
        uint256 ceilCoin = getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(finalSystemCoinPrice);
        uint256 boundedSystem = _bound(finalSystemCoinPrice, floorCoin, ceilCoin);

        if (boundedSystem == 0) return 0;
        return _wdiv(boundedCollateral, boundedSystem);
    }

    function getDiscountedCollateralPrice(
        uint256 collateralMedianPrice,
        uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice,
        uint256 lowerBound,
        uint256 upperBound
    ) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 base = getFinalBaseCollateralPrice(collateralMedianPrice, finalSystemCoinPrice);
        if (base == 0) return 0;

        uint256 discounted = _wmul(base, discount == 0 ? WAD : discount);

        if (lowerBound != 0 && discounted < lowerBound) discounted = lowerBound;
        if (upperBound != 0 && discounted > upperBound) discounted = upperBound;

        return discounted;
    }

    function getCollateralFSMAndFinalSystemCoinPrices(uint256 redemptionPriceHint) public returns (uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) {
        collateralMedianPrice = getCollateralMedianPrice();

        uint256 systemCoinMarketPrice = getSystemCoinMarketPrice();
        uint256 redemptionPrice = _readRedemptionPrice();

        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = redemptionPriceHint;
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = lastReadRedemptionPrice;
        if (redemptionPrice == 0) redemptionPrice = systemCoinMarketPrice;
        if (systemCoinMarketPrice == 0) systemCoinMarketPrice = redemptionPrice;

        uint256 floorPrice = getSystemCoinFloorDeviatedPrice(systemCoinMarketPrice);
        uint256 ceilPrice = getSystemCoinCeilingDeviatedPrice(systemCoinMarketPrice);
        finalSystemCoinPrice = _bound(redemptionPrice, floorPrice, ceilPrice);

        lastReadRedemptionPrice = finalSystemCoinPrice;
    }

    function getCollateralBought(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) public returns (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        if (auction.amountToSell == 0 || auction.amountToRaise == 0) return (0, 0);

        (uint256 collateralMedianPrice, uint256 finalSystemCoinPrice) = getCollateralFSMAndFinalSystemCoinPrices(lastReadRedemptionPrice);
        uint256 discountedCollateralPrice = getDiscountedCollateralPrice(collateralMedianPrice, finalSystemCoinPrice, 0, 0);
        if (discountedCollateralPrice == 0) return (0, 0);

        collateralBought = _wdiv(systemCoinsToBid, discountedCollateralPrice);

        uint256 remainingCollateral = remainingAmountToSell(id);
        if (collateralBought > remainingCollateral) collateralBought = remainingCollateral;

        adjustedBid = _wmul(collateralBought, discountedCollateralPrice);

        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (adjustedBid > remainingToRaise) {
            adjustedBid = remainingToRaise;
            collateralBought = discountedCollateralPrice == 0 ? 0 : _wdiv(adjustedBid, discountedCollateralPrice);
        }
    }

    function getAdjustedBid(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external returns (bool valid, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 bidValue) = getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
        if (collateralBought == 0 || bidValue == 0) return (false, 0);

        Bid storage auction = bids[id];
        uint256 remainingToRaise = auction.amountToRaise > auction.raisedAmount
            ? _sub(auction.amountToRaise, auction.raisedAmount)
            : 0;

        if (bidValue < minimumBid && remainingToRaise > minimumBid) return (false, 0);
        return (true, bidValue);
    }

    function getApproximateCollateralBought(uint256 id, uint256 systemCoinsToBid) external returns (uint256 collateralBought, uint256 adjustedBid) {
        return getCollateralBought(id, systemCoinsToBid);
    }

    // --- Internals ---
    function _transferCollateral(address src, address dst, uint256 wad) internal {
        if (wad == 0) return;
        require(_isContract(address(safeEngine)), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/safe-engine-not-set");
        safeEngine.transferCollateral(collateralType, src, dst, wad);
    }

    function _transferInternalCoins(address src, address dst, uint256 wad) internal {
        if (wad == 0) return;
        require(_isContract(address(safeEngine)), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/safe-engine-not-set");
        safeEngine.transferInternalCoins(src, dst, wad);
    }

    function _removeCoinsFromAuction(uint256 amount) internal {
        if (amount == 0 || liquidationEngine == address(0)) return;
        require(_isContract(liquidationEngine), "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/liquidation-engine-not-set");
        ILiquidationEngineLike(liquidationEngine).removeCoinsFromAuction(amount);
    }

    function _readRedemptionPrice() internal returns (uint256) {
        if (oracleRelayer == address(0) || !_isContract(oracleRelayer)) return lastReadRedemptionPrice;

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = oracleRelayer.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xc5b748c0)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return lastReadRedemptionPrice;

        uint256 redemptionPrice = abi.decode(data, (uint256));
        lastReadRedemptionPrice = redemptionPrice;
        return redemptionPrice;
    }

    function _tryReadAddress(address target, bytes4 sig) internal view returns (address value, bool ok) {
        if (target == address(0) || !_isContract(target)) return (address(0), false);

        (bool success, bytes memory data) = target.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(sig));
        if (!success || data.length < 32) return (address(0), false);

        value = abi.decode(data, (address));
        return (value, true);
    }

    function _tryGetResultWithValidity(address source) internal view returns (uint256 result, bool valid) {
        if (source == address(0) || !_isContract(source)) return (0, false);

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = source.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x4fd0ada8)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 64) return (0, false);

        (result, valid) = abi.decode(data, (uint256, bool));
        if (!valid) return (0, false);
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly { size := extcodesize(account) }
        return size > 0;
    }

    function _bound(uint256 x, uint256 min_, uint256 max_) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 low = min_;
        uint256 high = max_;
        if (low > high) {
            uint256 tmp = low;
            low = high;
            high = tmp;
        }

        if (x < low) return low;
        if (x > high) return high;
        return x;
    }

    function _wmul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _div(_mul(x, y), WAD);
    }

    function _wdiv(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return _div(_mul(x, WAD), y);
    }

    function _add(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        z = x + y;
        require(z >= x, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/add-overflow");
    }

    function _sub(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        require(y <= x, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/sub-underflow");
        z = x - y;
    }

    function _mul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        if (x == 0 || y == 0) return 0;
        z = x * y;
        require(z / x == y, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/mul-overflow");
    }

    function _div(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
        require(y > 0, "FixedDiscountCollateralAuctionHouse/div-by-zero");
        z = x / y;
    }

    function _min(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return x <= y ? x : y;
    }

    function _max(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return x >= y ? x : y;
    }
}

        _;
    }

        require(msg.sender == _superAdmin || msg.sender == _serviceAdmin, "not admin");
        _;

        address cService_,

        _cService = cService_;
        _cERC1155 = cERC1155_;
        _cStrongNFTBonus = cStrongNFTBonus_;
        _serviceAdmin = serviceAdmin_;

        return _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)].upperBound;

        _nftIdToNodeId[nftId] = nodeId;
        _nftIdToStakedAtBlock[nftId] = block.number;
        _nodeIdToStakedAtBlock[nodeId] = block.number;

        _entityNodeToNftId[msg.sender][nodeId] = nftId;
        _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[msg.sender][nodeId] = block.number;

        } else {

        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][service][nodeId];
        delete _entityServiceNodeToStakedAtTimestamp[entity][service][nodeId];

        if (_entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId] == nftId) {
            delete _entityNodeToNftId[entity][nodeId];
            delete _entityNodeToStakedAtBlock[entity][nodeId];

        if (_nftIdToNodeId[nftId] == nodeId) {

    function _computeBonus(
        address service,
        address entity,
        uint128 nodeId,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 minOut,
        uint256 maxOut
    ) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 nftId = getStakedNftId(entity, nodeId, service);
        if (nftId == 0) return 0;

        string memory bonusName = _findBonusNameForNft(nftId);
        if (bytes(bonusName).length == 0) return 0;

        bytes32 key = _hash(bonusName);
        uint256 bonus = _resolveBonusValue(service, key);
        if (bonus == 0) return 0;

        uint256 out = amount + ((amount * bonus) / 1e4);
        if (minOut != 0 && out < minOut) out = minOut;
        if (maxOut != 0 && out > maxOut) out = maxOut;
        return out;
    }

    function _resolveBonusValue(address service, bytes32 key) internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 serviceValue = _serviceBonusValue[service][key];
        if (serviceValue != 0) {
            uint256 eff = _serviceBonusEffectiveAt[service][key];
            if (eff == 0 || _currentMarker(service) >= eff) return serviceValue;
        }

        BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[key];
        if (cfg.value == 0) return 0;
        if (cfg.effectiveBlock != 0 && block.number < cfg.effectiveBlock) return 0;
        return cfg.value;
    }

    function _findBonusNameForNft(uint256 nftId) internal view returns (string memory) {
        uint256 len = _bonusNames.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            string memory name = _bonusNames[i];
            BonusConfig storage cfg = _bonusByNameHash[_hash(name)];
            if (nftId >= cfg.lowerBound) {
                if (cfg.upperBound == 0 || nftId <= cfg.upperBound) {
                    return name;
                }
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    function _hash(string memory s) internal pure returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(bytes(s));
    }

    function _ensureBonusNameExists(string calldata name) internal {
        bytes32 key = _hash(name);
        uint256 len = _bonusNames.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_hash(_bonusNames[i]) == key) return;
        }
        _bonusNames.push(name);
    }

    function _safeTransferIn(address from, uint256 nftId) internal {
        require(_cERC1155.code.length > 0, "CERC1155 not set");
        IERC1155Minimal(_cERC1155).safeTransferFrom(from, address(this), nftId, 1, "");
    }

    function _safeTransferOut(address to, uint256 nftId) internal {
        require(_cERC1155.code.length > 0, "CERC1155 not set");
        IERC1155Minimal(_cERC1155).safeTransferFrom(address(this), to, nftId, 1, "");
    }

    function _addEntityNft(address entity, uint256 nftId) internal {
        uint256[] storage arr = _entityStakedNftIds[entity];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == nftId) return;
        }
        arr.push(nftId);
    }

    function _removeEntityNft(address entity, uint256 nftId) internal {
        uint256[] storage arr = _entityStakedNftIds[entity];
        uint256 len = arr.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (arr[i] == nftId) {
                arr[i] = arr[len - 1];
                arr.pop();
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function _currentMarker(address service) internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _serviceUsesTimestamp[service] ? block.timestamp : block.number;
    }

    function _tryStaticBool(address target, bytes memory payload) internal view returns (bool ok, bool value) {
        bytes memory ret;
        (ok, ret) = target.staticcall(payload);
        if (!ok || ret.length < 32) return (false, false);
        value = abi.decode(ret, (bool));
    }

    function _serviceNodeExists(address service, address entity, uint128 nodeId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (service == address(0)) return true;
        (bool ok, bool exists) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x26665562), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return exists;
        (ok, exists) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x9daf08c0), entity, uint256(nodeId)));
        if (ok) return exists;
        return true;
    }

    function _serviceNodeExpired(address service, address entity, uint128 nodeId) internal view returns (bool) {
        if (service == address(0)) return false;
        (bool ok, bool expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xf1febd07), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return expired;
        (ok, expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x6c52ec10), entity, nodeId));
        if (ok) return expired;
        (ok, expired) = _tryStaticBool(service, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xd1c25be3), entity, uint256(nodeId)));
        if (ok) return expired;
        return false;
    }

            _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        }
        _poolBalance_[a][b] += amount;
        _totalStakes_[a][b] += amount;
    }

    function getHostTokens(address host, uint256 a, uint256 b) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = _hostTokenBuckets[host][a][b];
        if (msg.sender == host && amount > 0) {
            _hostTokenBuckets[host][a][b] = 0;
            _balances[host] += amount;
        }
        return amount;
    }

    function stakeBalance(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakeBalances[user];
    }

    function poolBalance(uint256 a, uint256 b) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _poolBalance_[a][b];
    }

    function hostUpdatesCounter() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostUpdatesCounter_;
    }

    function hostAddress(uint256 id) external view returns (address) {
        return _hostAddressById[id];
    }

    function lastPriceUpdate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lastPriceUpdate_;
    }

    function hostConnection(uint256 id) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _hostConnectionById[id];
    }

    function balanceOf(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _balances[user];
    }

    function stakeTmpBalance(uint256 a, uint256 b, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][user];
    }

    function stakeTokens(address host, uint256 amount) external {
        require(_hosts_[host].active, "HOST_INACTIVE");
        require(_balances[msg.sender] >= amount, "NO_BALANCE");

        _balances[msg.sender] -= amount;
        _stakeBalances[msg.sender] += amount;
        _stakesLockups_[msg.sender] = block.timestamp + _stakeLockTime_;

        uint256 hostId = _hostIdByAddress[host];
        _hostStakes_[hostId][0][msg.sender] += amount;
        _totalStakes_[hostId][0] += amount;
        _stakeTmpBalance_[hostId][0][msg.sender] += amount / 10;
        _stakeTokenBuckets[msg.sender][hostId][0] += amount;
        _hostTokenBuckets[host][hostId][0] += amount / 20;
        _hosts_[host].staked += amount;
    }

    function totalStakes(uint256 a, uint256 b) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalStakes_[a][b];
    }

    function sellDomain(
        string calldata domainName,
        address seller,
        address buyer,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 expiresAt
    ) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        require(d.exists, "NO_DOMAIN");
        require(d.owner == msg.sender || _domainAdmins[key][msg.sender] || seller == msg.sender, "NOT_ALLOWED");

        _domainSales[key] = SaleInfo({
            seller: seller == address(0) ? d.owner : seller,
            buyer: buyer,
            price: price,
            startedAt: block.timestamp,
            expiresAt: expiresAt,
            listed: true
        });
        return true;
    }

    function tokenPrice() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _tokenPrice_;
    }

    function updateHost(string calldata hostData) external returns (bool) {
        HostInfo storage h = _hosts_[msg.sender];
        require(h.active, "NOT_HOST");

        h.updatedAt = block.timestamp;
        h.meta = hostData;

        bytes32 c = keccak256(bytes(hostData));
        _hostConnectionById[h.id] = c;
        _hostConnectionDB_[c] = true;

        _hostUpdatesCounter_ += 1;
        _hostUpdates_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = block.timestamp;
        _hostUpdateNotes_[_hostUpdatesCounter_] = hostData;
        return true;
    }

    function getDomainFileHash(string calldata domainName, bytes32 fileKey) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _domainFileHashes[_domainKey(domainName)][fileKey];
    }

    function setOwOwner(address newOwner) external onlyOwOwner {
        require(newOwner != address(0), "BAD_OWNER");
        _owOwner = newOwner;
    }

    function registerDomain(string calldata domainName, uint256 duration) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        if (!_domains_[key].exists || block.timestamp > _domains_[key].expiresAt) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= _domainCost_, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= _domainCost_;
        }
        return _registerDomainInternal(domainName, msg.sender, duration);
    }

    function hostStakes(uint256 a, uint256 b, address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostStakes_[a][b][user];
    }

    function symbol() external view returns (string memory) {
        return _symbol_;
    }

    function publishCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _publishCost_;
    }

    function claimStakeTokens(uint256 a, uint256 b) external {
        uint256 amount = _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][msg.sender];
        require(amount > 0, "NO_AMOUNT");
        _stakeTmpBalance_[a][b][msg.sender] = 0;
        _poolBalanceClaimed_[a][b] += amount;
        _balances[msg.sender] += amount;
    }

    function tokenAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _tokenAddress_;
    }

    function users(address user) external view returns (bool, uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        UserInfo storage u = _users_[user];
        return (u.subscribed, u.subscribedUntil, u.credits, u.spent);
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        return _moveBalance(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function websiteUpdates(uint256 id) external view returns (string memory) {
        return _websiteUpdates_[id];
    }

    function hostUpdates(uint256 id) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostUpdates_[id];
    }

    function hosts(address host) external view returns (uint256, address, uint256, bool, uint256, uint256) {
        HostInfo storage h = _hosts_[host];
        return (h.id, h.wallet, h.staked, h.active, h.joinedAt, h.updatedAt);
    }

    function fetchTokenPrice() external payable {
        require(block.timestamp >= _lastPriceUpdate_ + 1 days, "TOO_EARLY");
        _lastPriceUpdate_ = block.timestamp;

        if (_cmcAddress_ != address(0)) {
            try IPriceOracle(_cmcAddress_).requestPrice(_symbol_) returns (uint256 p) {
                if (p > 0) _tokenPrice_ = p;
            } catch {}
        }
    }

    function totalSubscriber() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalSubscriber_;
    }

    function domains(bytes32 key)
        external
        view
        returns (
            string memory name,
            string memory websiteBlob,
            address owner_,
            uint256 createdAt,
            uint256 expiresAt,
            uint256 ttl,
            uint256 price,
            uint256 filesCount,
            uint256 updates,
            bytes32 websiteRoot
        )
    {
        Domain storage d = _domains_[key];
        return (d.name, d.websiteBlob, d.owner, d.createdAt, d.expiresAt, d.ttl, d.price, d.filesCount, d.updates, d.websiteRoot);
    }

    function burnPoolTokens(uint256 a, uint256 b) external onlyOwOwner {
        uint256 bal = _poolBalance_[a][b];
        uint256 burnAmount = bal / 2;
        _poolBalance_[a][b] = bal - burnAmount;
        _totalBurned_ += burnAmount;
    }

    function totalDomains() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalDomains_;
    }

    function cmcAddress() external view returns (address) {
        return _cmcAddress_;
    }

    function registryDuration() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _registryDuration_;
    }

    function removeDomainAdmin(string calldata domainName, address admin) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_domains_[key].owner == msg.sender, "NOT_OWNER");
        _domainAdmins[key][admin] = false;
        return true;
    }

    function cancelSellDomain(string calldata domainName) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        SaleInfo storage s = _domainSales[key];
        require(s.listed, "NOT_LISTED");
        require(msg.sender == s.seller || msg.sender == _domains_[key].owner, "NOT_ALLOWED");
        s.listed = false;
        return true;
    }

    function domainCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _domainCost_;
    }

    function userSubscribe(uint256 period) external {
        UserInfo storage u = _users_[msg.sender];
        if (!u.subscribed) {
            u.subscribed = true;
            _totalSubscriber_ += 1;
        }

        uint256 start = u.subscribedUntil > block.timestamp ? u.subscribedUntil : block.timestamp;
        u.subscribedUntil = start + period;
        u.credits += period;

        uint256 denom = _registryDuration_ == 0 ? 1 : _registryDuration_;
        uint256 cost = (period * _userSurfingCost_) / denom;
        if (cost > 0) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender] >= cost, "NO_BALANCE");
            _balances[msg.sender] -= cost;
            u.spent += cost;
        }
    }

    function getStakeTokens(address user, uint256 a, uint256 b) external returns (uint256) {
        uint256 amount = _stakeTokenBuckets[user][a][b];
        if (msg.sender == user && amount > 0) {
            _stakeTokenBuckets[user][a][b] = 0;
            _balances[user] += amount;
        }
        return amount;
    }

    function hostRegistryCost() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _hostRegistryCost_;
    }

    function websiteFilesLimit() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _websiteFilesLimit_;
    }

    function renewDomain(string calldata domainName) external returns (bool) {
        bytes32 key = _domainKey(domainName);
        require(_isDomainManager(key, msg.sender), "NOT_MANAGER");
        return _registerDomainInternal(domainName, _domains_[key].owner, _registryDuration_);
    }

    function totalHosts() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalHosts_;
    }

    function _currentPrice(uint256 baseAmount) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 basis = _tokenPrice_ == 0 ? baseAmount : (baseAmount * _tokenPrice_) / 1e18;
        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp > _lastPriceUpdate_ ? (block.timestamp - _lastPriceUpdate_) : 0;
        uint256 premium = (basis * elapsed) / 86400 / 100;
        return basis + premium;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable {}
}

                u.inviteCode = refCode;
                _users[ref2].directCount += 1;

        totalInvest = u.totalInvest;
        totalStaticClaimed = u.totalStaticClaimed;
        totalDynamicClaimed = u.totalDynamicClaimed;
        totalWithdrawn = u.totalWithdrawn;
        teamInvest = u.teamInvest;
        directCount = u.directCount;
        latestUnlockAmount = u.latestUnlockAmount;

            u.id = userCount;
            _indexMapping[userCount] = account;
            u.joinTime = block.timestamp;
            u.round = currentRound;
        }

        if (bytes(myCode).length > 0) {
            bytes32 codeKey = _stringKey(myCode);
            address existing = _codeToUser[codeKey];
            require(existing == address(0) || existing == account, "invite code is used");

            u.myCode = myCode;

        if (u.referrer == address(0) && referrer != address(0)) {

            u.inviteCode = refCode;
            _users[referrer].directCount += 1;

        User storage u = _users[account];

        require(u.totalInvest + amount <= baseAmount * 2000, "can not beyond 2000 eth");

        u.totalInvest += amount;
        u.round = currentRound;
        u.orders.push(
            Order({
                amount: amount,
                principal: amount,
                startAt: block.timestamp,
                unlockAt: block.timestamp + 30 days,
                claimedStatic: 0
            })
        );

        _specialUsers[currentRound].push(account);

        address up = u.referrer;
        uint256 depth = 1;

            if (rate > 0) {

            uint256 elapsedDays = block.timestamp > o.startAt ? (block.timestamp - o.startAt) / 1 days : 0;
            if (elapsedDays > 30) elapsedDays = 30;

            if (gross > o.claimedStatic) {
                pending += (gross - o.claimedStatic);
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

            Order storage o = u.orders[i];
            uint256 elapsedDays = block.timestamp > o.startAt ? (block.timestamp - o.startAt) / 1 days : 0;
            if (elapsedDays > 30) elapsedDays = 30;

            uint256 gross = (o.amount * coefficient * elapsedDays) / 1000;
            if (gross > o.claimedStatic) {
                uint256 delta = gross - o.claimedStatic;
                o.claimedStatic = gross;
                collected += delta;
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

        User storage u = _users[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < u.orders.length; ) {
            Order storage o = u.orders[i];
            if (o.principal > 0 && block.timestamp >= o.unlockAt) {
                amount += o.principal;
                o.principal = 0;
            }
            unchecked {
                ++i;
            }
        }
    }

    function _stageOf(uint256 invested) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (invested < baseAmount) return 0;
        if (invested <= baseAmount * 500) return 1;
        if (invested <= baseAmount * 1000) return 2;
        return 3;
    }

    function _dynamicRate(uint256 stage, uint256 depth) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (stage == 1) {
            if (depth == 1) return 50;
            return 0;
        }
        if (stage == 2) {
            if (depth == 1) return 70;
            if (depth == 2) return 50;

        require(_callResult(ok, data), "transferFrom failed");

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(token != address(0), "token not set");

        require(_callResult(ok, data), "transfer failed");

        if (!ok) return false;
        if (data.length == 0) return true;
        if (data.length >= 32) return abi.decode(data, (bool));
        return false;
    }

contract Cauldron {

        uint128 elastic;
        uint128 base;
    }

    struct AccrueInfoData {
        uint64 lastAccrued;
        uint128 feesEarned;
        uint64 INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
    }

    struct BorrowLimitData {
        uint128 total;
        uint128 borrowPartPerAddress;
    }

    struct InitData {
        address bentoBox;
        address masterContract;
        address magicInternetMoney;
        address collateral;
        address oracle;
        bytes oracleData;
        uint64 interestPerSecond;
        uint256 liquidationMultiplier;
        uint256 collaterizationRate;
        uint256 borrowOpeningFee;
    }

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event LogExchangeRate(uint256 rate);
    event LogInterestChange(uint64 oldInterestRate, uint64 newInterestRate);
    event LogAddCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 share);
    event LogRemoveCollateral(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 share);
    event LogBorrow(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 part);
    event LogRepay(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount, uint256 part);
    event LogLiquidation(address indexed liquidator, address indexed user, address indexed to, uint256 borrowPart, uint256 borrowAmount, uint256 collateralShare);
    event LogWithdrawFees(address indexed feeTo, uint256 feesEarned);
    event LogFeeTo(address indexed newFeeTo);
    event LogAccrue(uint128 extraAmount);
    event LogChangeBorrowLimit(uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress);

    address public owner;
    address public pendingOwner;
    address public feeTo;

    address public bentoBox;
    address public masterContract;
    address public magicInternetMoney;

    IERC20 public collateral;
    IOracle public oracle;
    bytes public oracleData;

    uint256 public exchangeRate;
    uint256 public totalCollateralShare;

    mapping(address => uint256) public userCollateralShare;
    mapping(address => uint256) public userBorrowPart;

    uint256 public LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER;
    uint256 public COLLATERIZATION_RATE;
    uint256 public BORROW_OPENING_FEE;

    Rebase private _totalBorrow;
    AccrueInfoData private _accrueInfo;
    BorrowLimitData private _borrowLimit;
    uint64 public lastInterestUpdate;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        require(msg.sender == owner, "Ownable: caller is not the owner");
        _;
    }

    constructor() public {
        owner = msg.sender;
        feeTo = msg.sender;
        LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER = 112000;
        COLLATERIZATION_RATE = 75000;
        BORROW_OPENING_FEE = 50;
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = 317097920;
    }

    function _bento() internal view returns (IBentoBox) {
        return IBentoBox(bentoBox);
    }

    function _requireBentoOwner() internal view {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) {
            require(msg.sender == owner, "Caller is not the owner");
        } else {

        }
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner, bool direct, bool renounce) external onlyOwner {

    function setFeeTo(address newFeeTo) external onlyOwner {

        emit LogFeeTo(newFeeTo);
    }

    function init(bytes calldata data) external payable {

        bentoBox = x.bentoBox;
        masterContract = x.masterContract;

        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = x.interestPerSecond;
        _accrueInfo.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);

        LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER = x.liquidationMultiplier;
        COLLATERIZATION_RATE = x.collaterizationRate;
        BORROW_OPENING_FEE = x.borrowOpeningFee;

    function totalBorrow() external view returns (uint128 elastic, uint128 base) {
        elastic = _totalBorrow.elastic;
        base = _totalBorrow.base;
    }

    function accrueInfo() external view returns (uint64 lastAccrued, uint128 feesEarned, uint64 INTEREST_PER_SECOND_) {
        lastAccrued = _accrueInfo.lastAccrued;
        feesEarned = _accrueInfo.feesEarned;
        INTEREST_PER_SECOND_ = _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
    }

    function borrowLimit() external view returns (uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress) {
        total = _borrowLimit.total;
        borrowPartPerAddress = _borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress;
    }

    function _toShare(address token, uint256 amount, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) return amount;
        return _bento().toShare(token, amount, roundUp);
    }

    function _toAmount(address token, uint256 share, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (bentoBox == address(0)) return share;
        return _bento().toAmount(token, share, roundUp);
    }

    function _amountToPart(uint256 amount, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256 part) {
        uint256 elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        uint256 base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base);
        if (elastic == 0) {
            part = amount;
        } else {
            part = amount.mul(base) / elastic;
            if (roundUp && part.mul(elastic) / base < amount) {
                part = part.add(1);
            }
        }
    }

    function _partToAmount(uint256 part, bool roundUp) internal view returns (uint256 amount) {
        uint256 elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        uint256 base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base);
        if (base == 0) {
            amount = part;
        } else {
            amount = part.mul(elastic) / base;
            if (roundUp && amount.mul(base) / elastic < part) {
                amount = amount.add(1);
            }
        }
    }

    function updateExchangeRate() public returns (bool updated, uint256 rate) {
        if (address(oracle) == address(0)) {
            return (false, exchangeRate);
        }

        (updated, rate) = oracle.get(oracleData);
        if (updated) {
            exchangeRate = rate;
            emit LogExchangeRate(rate);
        } else {
            rate = exchangeRate;
        }
    }

    function accrue() public {

        if (info.lastAccrued == 0) {
            info.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);
            _accrueInfo = info;
            return;
        }

        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp.sub(uint256(info.lastAccrued));
        if (elapsed == 0) return;

        info.lastAccrued = uint64(block.timestamp);

        if (_totalBorrow.base > 0 && info.INTEREST_PER_SECOND > 0) {
            uint256 extraAmount = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).mul(uint256(info.INTEREST_PER_SECOND)).mul(elapsed) / 1e18;

                uint128 extraAmount128 = extraAmount.to128();
                _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).add(extraAmount).to128();
                info.feesEarned = uint256(info.feesEarned).add(extraAmount).to128();
                emit LogAccrue(extraAmount128);
            }
        }

        _accrueInfo = info;
    }

    function _isSolvent(address user, uint256 rate) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 part = userBorrowPart[user];
        if (part == 0) return true;
        if (rate == 0) return false;

        uint256 borrowAmount = _partToAmount(part, false);
        uint256 cShare = userCollateralShare[user];
        uint256 cAmount = _toAmount(address(collateral), cShare, false);

        uint256 collateralValue = cAmount.mul(COLLATERIZATION_RATE).mul(1e18).div(1e5).div(rate);
        return collateralValue >= borrowAmount;
    }

    function addCollateral(address to, bool skim, uint256 share) public {
        if (share == 0) return;

        if (!skim && bentoBox != address(0)) {
            _bento().transfer(address(collateral), msg.sender, address(this), share);
        }

        userCollateralShare[to] = userCollateralShare[to].add(share);
        totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.add(share);

        emit LogAddCollateral(skim ? address(this) : msg.sender, to, share);
    }

    function removeCollateral(address to, uint256 share) public {
        accrue();

        userCollateralShare[msg.sender] = userCollateralShare[msg.sender].sub(share);
        totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.sub(share);

        uint256 rate = exchangeRate;
        if (rate == 0) {
            (, rate) = updateExchangeRate();
        }

        if (bentoBox != address(0)) {
            _bento().transfer(address(collateral), address(this), to, share);
        }

        emit LogRemoveCollateral(msg.sender, to, share);
    }

    function borrow(address to, uint256 amount) public returns (uint256 part, uint256 share) {
        accrue();

            require(uint256(_totalBorrow.base).add(part) <= uint256(_borrowLimit.total), "Cauldron: borrow limit reached");
        }

            require(userBorrowPart[msg.sender].add(part) <= uint256(_borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress), "Cauldron: borrow limit reached");
        }

        }

            share = amount;
        }

        emit LogBorrow(msg.sender, to, amount, part);
    }

    function repay(address to, bool skim, uint256 part) public returns (uint256 amount) {
        accrue();

        if (part == 0) {
            part = userBorrowPart[to];
        }

        amount = _partToAmount(part, false);

        if (!skim && bentoBox != address(0) && magicInternetMoney != address(0)) {
            uint256 share = _toShare(magicInternetMoney, amount, true);
            _bento().transfer(magicInternetMoney, msg.sender, address(this), share);
        }

        userBorrowPart[to] = userBorrowPart[to].sub(part);
        _totalBorrow.base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base).sub(part).to128();
        _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();

        emit LogRepay(skim ? address(this) : msg.sender, to, amount, part);
    }

    function liquidate(address[] calldata users, uint256[] calldata maxBorrowParts, address to, address swapper) external {
        swapper;
        require(users.length == maxBorrowParts.length, "Cauldron: bad len");

        accrue();

        uint256 rate = exchangeRate;
        if (rate == 0) {
            (, rate) = updateExchangeRate();
        }
        require(rate > 0, "Cauldron: rate not ok");

        bool allSolvent = true;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < users.length; i++) {
            address user = users[i];
            if (_isSolvent(user, rate)) continue;

            allSolvent = false;

            uint256 userPart = userBorrowPart[user];
            uint256 part = maxBorrowParts[i] > userPart ? userPart : maxBorrowParts[i];
            if (part == 0) continue;

            uint256 amount = _partToAmount(part, false);
            uint256 collateralAmount = amount.mul(LIQUIDATION_MULTIPLIER).mul(rate).div(1e23);
            uint256 collateralShare = _toShare(address(collateral), collateralAmount, false);

            if (collateralShare > uShare) collateralShare = uShare;

            userBorrowPart[user] = userPart.sub(part);
            _totalBorrow.base = uint256(_totalBorrow.base).sub(part).to128();
            _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();

            totalCollateralShare = totalCollateralShare.sub(collateralShare);

            }

            emit LogLiquidation(msg.sender, user, to, part, amount, collateralShare);
        }

        require(!allSolvent, "Cauldron: all are solvent");
    }

    function withdrawFees() external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        accrue();

        uint256 feesEarned = uint256(_accrueInfo.feesEarned);
        _accrueInfo.feesEarned = 0;

        if (feesEarned > 0 && bentoBox != address(0) && magicInternetMoney != address(0) && feeTo != address(0)) {
            uint256 share = _toShare(magicInternetMoney, feesEarned, false);
            _bento().transfer(magicInternetMoney, address(this), feeTo, share);
        }

        emit LogWithdrawFees(feeTo, feesEarned);
    }

    function reduceSupply(uint256 amount) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        accrue();

        if (amount > uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic)) {
            amount = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic);
        }

        _totalBorrow.elastic = uint256(_totalBorrow.elastic).sub(amount).to128();
        if (_totalBorrow.base > _totalBorrow.elastic) {
            _totalBorrow.base = _totalBorrow.elastic;
        }
    }

    function changeBorrowLimit(uint128 total, uint128 borrowPartPerAddress) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();
        _borrowLimit.total = total;
        _borrowLimit.borrowPartPerAddress = borrowPartPerAddress;
        emit LogChangeBorrowLimit(total, borrowPartPerAddress);
    }

    function changeInterestRate(uint64 newInterestPerSecond) external {
        _requireBentoOwner();

        uint64 oldRate = _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND;
        if (oldRate > 0) {
            require(uint256(newInterestPerSecond) <= uint256(oldRate).add(uint256(oldRate).mul(75).div(100)), "Interest rate increase > 75%");
        }

        require(block.timestamp >= uint256(lastInterestUpdate).add(3 days), "Update only every 3 days");

        accrue();
        lastInterestUpdate = uint64(block.timestamp);
        _accrueInfo.INTEREST_PER_SECOND = newInterestPerSecond;

        emit LogInterestChange(oldRate, newInterestPerSecond);
    }

    function cook(uint8[] calldata actions, uint256[] calldata values, bytes[] calldata datas) external payable returns (uint256 value1, uint256 value2) {

        }

        }
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721Metadata: URI query for nonexistent token");
        uint256 mouldId = _boxToMould[tokenId];
        BoxMould storage mould = _boxMoulds[mouldId];

        if (bytes(_baseTokenURI).length == 0) {
            if (bytes(mould.uri0).length > 0) return mould.uri0;
            return _toString(tokenId);
        }

        if (bytes(mould.uri0).length == 0) {
            return string.concat(_baseTokenURI, _toString(tokenId));
        }

        return string.concat(_baseTokenURI, mould.uri0);
    }

    function updateURI(string calldata newURI) external onlyOwner {
        _baseTokenURI = newURI;
    }

    function updateSecondaryFee(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner {
        _secondaryFee = fee;
    }

    function setVendingMachine(address machine) external onlyOwner {
        vendingMachine = machine;
    }

    function updateTeamAddress(address newTeamAddress) external onlyOwner {
        _teamAddress = newTeamAddress;
    }

    function setCaller(address caller, bool allowed) external onlyOwner {
        authorisedCaller[caller] = allowed;
    }

    function addTeamMember(address member) external onlyOwner {
        require(!_isTeamMember[member], "NFTBoxes: members exists already");
        _isTeamMember[member] = true;
        _teamMembers.push(member);
    }

    function removeTeamMember(address member) external onlyOwner {
        if (!_isTeamMember[member]) return;
        _isTeamMember[member] = false;
        teamShare[member] = 0;

        uint256 len = _teamMembers.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (_teamMembers[i] == member) {
                _teamMembers[i] = _teamMembers[len - 1];
                _teamMembers.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    function team(uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        return _teamMembers[index];
    }

    function setTeamShare(address member, uint256 shareBps) external onlyOwner {
        require(shareBps <= TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: share must be below 1000");
        if (!_isTeamMember[member]) {
            _isTeamMember[member] = true;
            _teamMembers.push(member);
        }
        teamShare[member] = shareBps;
    }

    function createBoxMould(
        uint128 maxBoxes,
        uint128 maxPerMint,
        uint256 price,
        address[] calldata artists,
        uint256[] calldata artistShares_,
        string calldata uri0,
        string calldata uri1,
        string calldata uri2,
        string calldata uri3,
        string calldata uri4
    ) external onlyOwner {
        require(artists.length == artistShares_.length, "NFTBoxes: arrays are not of same length");

        uint256 sum;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artistShares_.length; i++) {
            sum += artistShares_[i];
        }
        require(sum == TOTAL_SHARES, "NFTBoxes: shares do not add up to 1000");

        uint256 mouldId = boxMouldCount;
        boxMouldCount = mouldId + 1;

        BoxMould storage mould = _boxMoulds[mouldId];
        mould.closed = false;
        mould.distributed = false;
        mould.exists = true;
        mould.maxBoxes = maxBoxes;
        mould.maxPerMint = maxPerMint;
        mould.minted = 0;
        mould.price = price;
        mould.uri0 = uri0;
        mould.uri1 = uri1;
        mould.uri2 = uri2;
        mould.uri3 = uri3;
        mould.uri4 = uri4;

        delete mould.artists;
        delete mould.artistShares;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artists.length; i++) {
            mould.artists.push(artists[i]);
            mould.artistShares.push(artistShares_[i]);
        }

        emit BoxMouldCreated(mouldId);
    }

    function boxMoulds(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (BoxMouldView memory out) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        BoxMould storage m = _boxMoulds[mouldId];
        out.closed = m.closed;
        out.distributed = m.distributed;
        out.exists = m.exists;
        out.maxBoxes = m.maxBoxes;
        out.maxPerMint = m.maxPerMint;
        out.minted = m.minted;
        out.price = m.price;
        out.artists = _copyAddressArray(m.artists);
        out.artistShares = _copyUintArray(m.artistShares);
        out.uri0 = m.uri0;
        out.uri1 = m.uri1;
        out.uri2 = m.uri2;
        out.uri3 = m.uri3;
        out.uri4 = m.uri4;
    }

    function addArtists(uint256 mouldId, address artist, uint256 shareBps) external onlyOwner {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        BoxMould storage m = _boxMoulds[mouldId];
        m.artists.push(artist);
        m.artistShares.push(shareBps);
    }

    function removeArtist(uint256 mouldId, address artist) external onlyOwner {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        BoxMould storage m = _boxMoulds[mouldId];
        uint256 len = m.artists.length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (m.artists[i] == artist) {
                m.artists[i] = m.artists[len - 1];
                m.artistShares[i] = m.artistShares[len - 1];
                m.artists.pop();
                m.artistShares.pop();
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    function getArtist(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        return _copyAddressArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artists);
    }

    function getArtistShares(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        return _copyUintArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artistShares);
    }

    function getArtistRoyalties(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (address[] memory, uint256[] memory) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        return (
            _copyAddressArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artists),
            _copyUintArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artistShares)
        );
    }

    function getFeeRecipients(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        return _copyAddressArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artists);
    }

    function getFeeBps(uint256 mouldId) external view returns (uint256[] memory) {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        return _copyUintArray(_boxMoulds[mouldId].artistShares);
    }

    function setLockOnBox(uint256 mouldId, bool locked) external onlyAuthorised {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        lockedBoxes[mouldId] = locked;
    }

    function closeBox(uint256 mouldId) external onlyAuthorised {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        _boxMoulds[mouldId].closed = true;
    }

    function buyManyBoxes(uint256 mouldId, uint128 amount) external payable {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        BoxMould storage mould = _boxMoulds[mouldId];

        require(!lockedBoxes[mouldId], "NFTBoxes: Box is locked");
        require(!mould.closed, "NFTBoxes: Box is locked");
        require(amount > 0, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");

        if (mould.maxPerMint > 0) {
            require(amount <= mould.maxPerMint, "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");
        }

        require(uint256(mould.minted) + uint256(amount) <= uint256(mould.maxBoxes), "NFTBoxes: Cannot buy this many boxes");

        uint256 totalPrice = mould.price * uint256(amount);
        require(msg.value == totalPrice, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        mould.minted += amount;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < amount; i++) {
            uint256 tokenId = _nextTokenId++;
            _safeMint(msg.sender, tokenId);
            _boxToMould[tokenId] = mouldId;
            _boxSeed[tokenId] = _newSeed(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(tokenId, msg.sender, block.number)));
        }

        emit BoxBought(mouldId, amount, totalPrice);
    }

    function boxes(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (BoxView memory) {
        return _boxInfo(tokenId);
    }

    function getBoxMetaData(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (BoxView memory) {
        return _boxInfo(tokenId);
    }

    function _getNewSeed(bytes32 seed) external view returns (bytes32) {
        return _newSeed(seed);
    }

    function distributeShares(uint256 mouldId) external onlyAuthorised {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        BoxMould storage mould = _boxMoulds[mouldId];

        require(mould.closed, "NFTBoxes: Box is still live, cannot distribute shares");
        require(!mould.distributed, "NFTBoxes: cannot distribute shares");
        mould.distributed = true;

        uint256 bal = address(this).balance;
        if (bal == 0) return;

        uint256 paid;
        uint256 artistLen = mould.artists.length;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < artistLen; i++) {
            uint256 amount = (bal * mould.artistShares[i]) / TOTAL_SHARES;
            if (amount > 0 && mould.artists[i] != address(0)) {
                paid += amount;
                (bool ok, ) = payable(mould.artists[i]).call{value: amount}("");
                require(ok, "transfer failed");
            }
        }

        uint256 remainder = bal - paid;
        address sink = _teamAddress == address(0) ? _owner : _teamAddress;
        if (remainder > 0 && sink != address(0)) {
            (bool ok2, ) = payable(sink).call{value: remainder}("");
            require(ok2, "transfer failed");
        }
    }

    function distributeOffchain(uint256 mouldId, address[][] calldata recipients, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyAuthorised {
        _requireMould(mouldId);
        require(recipients.length == amounts.length, "NFTBoxes: Wrong array size.");

        if (vendingMachine == address(0)) return;
        require(vendingMachine.code.length > 0, "Address: call to non-contract");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            uint256 n = amounts[i];
            if (n > recipients[i].length) n = recipients[i].length;

            for (uint256 j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                IVendingMachine(vendingMachine).NFTMachineFor(mouldId, recipients[i][j]);
            }
        }
    }

    function _boxInfo(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (BoxView memory out) {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        uint256 mouldId = _boxToMould[tokenId];
        BoxMould storage mould = _boxMoulds[mouldId];

        out.closed = mould.closed;
        out.distributed = mould.distributed;
        out.locked = lockedBoxes[mouldId];
        out.mouldId = mouldId;
        out.tokenId = tokenId;
        out.price = mould.price;
        out.seed = uint256(_boxSeed[tokenId]);
        out.artists = _copyAddressArray(mould.artists);
        out.artistShares = _copyUintArray(mould.artistShares);
        out.uri0 = mould.uri0;
        out.uri1 = mould.uri1;
        out.uri2 = mould.uri2;
        out.uri3 = mould.uri3;
        out.uri4 = mould.uri4;
    }

    function _safeMint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _mint(to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(address(0), to, tokenId, ""), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _beforeTokenTransfer(address(0), to, tokenId);

        _owners[tokenId] = to;
        _balances[to] += 1;

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender || _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][spender]);
    }

    function _approve(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = spender;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), spender, tokenId);
    }

    function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        if (from == address(0)) {
            _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
            _allTokens.push(tokenId);
        } else if (from != to) {
            uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
            uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

            if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
                uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
                _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
                _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
            }

            _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        }

        if (to == address(0)) {
            uint256 lastGlobalIndex = _allTokens.length - 1;
            uint256 tokenGlobalIndex = _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
            uint256 lastTokenIdGlobal = _allTokens[lastGlobalIndex];

            _allTokens[tokenGlobalIndex] = lastTokenIdGlobal;
            _allTokensIndex[lastTokenIdGlobal] = tokenGlobalIndex;

            _allTokens.pop();
            delete _allTokensIndex[tokenId];
        } else if (to != from) {
            _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
            _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
        }
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _newSeed(bytes32 seed) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(seed, block.timestamp, block.prevrandao, msg.sender, address(this)));
    }

    function _requireMould(uint256 mouldId) internal view {
        require(mouldId < boxMouldCount && _boxMoulds[mouldId].exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");
    }

    function _copyAddressArray(address[] storage src) internal view returns (address[] memory out) {
        out = new address[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            out[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _copyUintArray(uint256[] storage src) internal view returns (uint256[] memory out) {
        out = new uint256[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            out[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address oldOwner = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(oldOwner, newOwner);
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 ptr = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            ptr--;
            buffer[ptr] = bytes1(uint8(48 + uint256(temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        return string(buffer);
    }
