    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public compSupplierIndex;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public compBorrowerIndex;
    mapping(address => CompState) internal compSupplyStates;
    mapping(address => CompState) internal compBorrowStates;

    mapping(address => uint256) public creditLimits;
    mapping(address => bool) public isCreditAccount;

    event Failure(uint256 error, uint256 info, uint256 detail);

    event MarketListed(address cToken);
    event MarketEntered(address cToken, address account);
    event MarketExited(address cToken, address account);

    event NewCloseFactor(uint256 oldCloseFactorMantissa, uint256 newCloseFactorMantissa);
    event NewCollateralFactor(address cToken, uint256 oldCollateralFactorMantissa, uint256 newCollateralFactorMantissa);
    event NewLiquidationIncentive(uint256 oldLiquidationIncentiveMantissa, uint256 newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa);
    event NewPriceOracle(address oldPriceOracle, address newPriceOracle);

    event NewPauseGuardian(address oldPauseGuardian, address newPauseGuardian);
    event ActionPaused(address cToken, string action, bool pauseState);
    event ActionPaused(string action, bool pauseState);

    event NewBorrowCap(address indexed cToken, uint256 newBorrowCap);
    event NewSupplyCap(address indexed cToken, uint256 newSupplyCap);
    event NewBorrowCapGuardian(address oldBorrowCapGuardian, address newBorrowCapGuardian);
    event NewSupplyCapGuardian(address oldSupplyCapGuardian, address newSupplyCapGuardian);

    event MarketDelisted(address cToken);
    event NewCTokenVersion(address cToken, uint8 oldVersion, uint8 newVersion);
    event CreditLimitChanged(address account, uint256 newLimit);

    constructor() public {
        admin = msg.sender;
        pauseGuardian = msg.sender;
        borrowCapGuardian = msg.sender;
        supplyCapGuardian = msg.sender;
        comptrollerImplementation = address(this);

        closeFactorMantissa = 5e17;
        liquidationIncentiveMantissa = 108e16;
        maxAssets = 10;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin");
        _;
    }

    function markets(address cToken) external view returns (bool, uint256, bool) {
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        return (m.isListed, m.collateralFactorMantissa, m.isComped);
    }

    function compSupplyState(address cToken) external view returns (uint224, uint32) {
        CompState storage s = compSupplyStates[cToken];
        return (s.index, s.blockNumber);
    }

    function compBorrowState(address cToken) external view returns (uint224, uint32) {
        CompState storage s = compBorrowStates[cToken];
        return (s.index, s.blockNumber);
    }

    function accountAssets(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (address) {
        require(index < accountAssetsList[account].length, "asset index out of bounds");
        return accountAssetsList[account][index];
    }

    function getAssetsIn(address account) external view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint256 len = accountAssetsList[account].length;
        address[] memory out = new address[](len);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            out[i] = accountAssetsList[account][i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    function getAllMarkets() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        uint256 len = allMarkets.length;
        address[] memory out = new address[](len);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            out[i] = allMarkets[i];
        }
        return out;
    }

    function checkMembership(address account, address cToken) external view returns (bool) {
        return marketsData[cToken].accountMembership[account];
    }

    function getBlockNumber() public view returns (uint256) {
        return block.number;
    }

    function _mintGuardianPaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return mintGuardianPausedGlobal;
    }

    function _borrowGuardianPaused() external view returns (bool) {
        return borrowGuardianPausedGlobal;
    }

    function _setPriceOracle(address newOracle) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        address oldOracle = oracle;
        oracle = newOracle;
        emit NewPriceOracle(oldOracle, newOracle);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _setCloseFactor(uint256 newCloseFactorMantissa) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        if (newCloseFactorMantissa == 0 || newCloseFactorMantissa > 9e17) {
            return _fail(INVALID_COLLATERAL_FACTOR, 0);
        }
        uint256 oldClose = closeFactorMantissa;
        closeFactorMantissa = newCloseFactorMantissa;
        emit NewCloseFactor(oldClose, newCloseFactorMantissa);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _setLiquidationIncentive(uint256 newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        if (newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa < EXP_SCALE || newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa > 150e16) {
            return _fail(INVALID_COLLATERAL_FACTOR, 0);
        }
        uint256 oldValue = liquidationIncentiveMantissa;
        liquidationIncentiveMantissa = newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa;
        emit NewLiquidationIncentive(oldValue, newLiquidationIncentiveMantissa);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _supportMarket(address cToken, uint8 version) external returns (uint256) {
        require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin may support market");

        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        require(!m.isListed, "market already listed");
        require(ICTokenLike(cToken).isCToken(), "not a CToken");

        m.isListed = true;
        m.isComped = true;
        m.version = version;

        allMarkets.push(cToken);

        emit MarketListed(cToken);
        emit NewCTokenVersion(cToken, 0, version);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function updateCTokenVersion(address cToken, uint8 newVersion) external {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == cToken, "unauthorized");
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        require(m.isListed, "market not listed");
        uint8 oldVersion = m.version;
        m.version = newVersion;
        emit NewCTokenVersion(cToken, oldVersion, newVersion);
    }

    function _setCollateralFactor(address cToken, uint256 newCollateralFactorMantissa) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        if (!m.isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (newCollateralFactorMantissa > 9e17) return _fail(INVALID_COLLATERAL_FACTOR, 0);
        if (newCollateralFactorMantissa != 0 && _getOraclePrice(cToken) == 0) return _fail(PRICE_ERROR, 0);

        uint256 oldFactor = m.collateralFactorMantissa;
        m.collateralFactorMantissa = newCollateralFactorMantissa;
        emit NewCollateralFactor(cToken, oldFactor, newCollateralFactorMantissa);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _setPauseGuardian(address newPauseGuardian) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        address old = pauseGuardian;
        pauseGuardian = newPauseGuardian;
        emit NewPauseGuardian(old, newPauseGuardian);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _setTransferPaused(bool state) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == pauseGuardian, "only admin or pause guardian");
        require(state || msg.sender == admin, "only admin can unpause");
        transferGuardianPaused = state;
        emit ActionPaused("Transfer", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setSeizePaused(bool state) external returns (bool) {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == pauseGuardian, "only admin or pause guardian");
        require(state || msg.sender == admin, "only admin can unpause");
        seizeGuardianPaused = state;
        emit ActionPaused("Seize", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setMintPaused(address cToken, bool state) external returns (bool) {
        require(marketsData[cToken].isListed, "cannot pause unlisted market");
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == pauseGuardian, "only admin or pause guardian");
        require(state || msg.sender == admin, "only admin can unpause");
        mintGuardianPaused[cToken] = state;
        emit ActionPaused(cToken, "Mint", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setBorrowPaused(address cToken, bool state) external returns (bool) {
        require(marketsData[cToken].isListed, "cannot pause unlisted market");
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == pauseGuardian, "only admin or pause guardian");
        require(state || msg.sender == admin, "only admin can unpause");
        borrowGuardianPaused[cToken] = state;
        emit ActionPaused(cToken, "Borrow", state);
        return state;
    }

    function _setBorrowCapGuardian(address newBorrowCapGuardian) external onlyAdmin {
        address old = borrowCapGuardian;
        borrowCapGuardian = newBorrowCapGuardian;
        emit NewBorrowCapGuardian(old, newBorrowCapGuardian);
    }

    function _setSupplyCapGuardian(address newSupplyCapGuardian) external onlyAdmin {
        address old = supplyCapGuardian;
        supplyCapGuardian = newSupplyCapGuardian;
        emit NewSupplyCapGuardian(old, newSupplyCapGuardian);
    }

    function _setMarketBorrowCaps(address[] calldata cTokens, uint256[] calldata newBorrowCaps) external {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == borrowCapGuardian, "only admin or borrow cap guardian");
        require(cTokens.length == newBorrowCaps.length, "mismatched lengths");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cTokens.length; i++) {
            borrowCaps[cTokens[i]] = newBorrowCaps[i];
            emit NewBorrowCap(cTokens[i], newBorrowCaps[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setMarketSupplyCaps(address[] calldata cTokens, uint256[] calldata newSupplyCaps) external {
        require(msg.sender == admin || msg.sender == supplyCapGuardian, "only admin or supply cap guardian");
        require(cTokens.length == newSupplyCaps.length, "mismatched lengths");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < cTokens.length; i++) {
            supplyCaps[cTokens[i]] = newSupplyCaps[i];
            emit NewSupplyCap(cTokens[i], newSupplyCaps[i]);
        }
    }

    function _setCreditLimit(address account, uint256 newLimit) external returns (uint256) {
        if (msg.sender != admin) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        creditLimits[account] = newLimit;
        isCreditAccount[account] = newLimit > 0;
        emit CreditLimitChanged(account, newLimit);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _delistMarket(address cToken) external onlyAdmin {
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        require(m.isListed, "market not listed");
        require(ICTokenLike(cToken).totalSupply() == 0, "market not empty");
        require(ICTokenLike(cToken).totalBorrows() == 0, "market not empty");

        m.isListed = false;
        m.isComped = false;
        m.collateralFactorMantissa = 0;
        m.version = 0;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < allMarkets.length; i++) {
            if (allMarkets[i] == cToken) {
                allMarkets[i] = allMarkets[allMarkets.length - 1];
                allMarkets.length = allMarkets.length - 1;
                break;
            }
        }

        emit MarketDelisted(cToken);
    }

    function _become(address unitroller) external {
        require(msg.sender == IUnitrollerLike(unitroller).admin(), "only unitroller admin");
        require(IUnitrollerLike(unitroller)._acceptImplementation(), "accept implementation failed");
    }

    function enterMarkets(address[] calldata cTokens) external returns (uint256[] memory) {
        uint256 len = cTokens.length;
        uint256[] memory results = new uint256[](len);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            results[i] = _addToMarketInternal(cTokens[i], msg.sender);
        }

        return results;
    }

    function exitMarket(address cToken) external returns (uint256) {
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        if (!m.accountMembership[msg.sender]) {
            return NO_ERROR;
        }

        (uint256 oErr, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBalance, ) = ICTokenLike(cToken).getAccountSnapshot(msg.sender);
        if (oErr != 0) return _fail(oErr, 0);
        if (borrowBalance != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(msg.sender, cToken, cTokenBalance, 0);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        m.accountMembership[msg.sender] = false;
        _removeAsset(msg.sender, cToken);

        emit MarketExited(cToken, msg.sender);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function mintAllowed(address cToken, address minter, uint256 mintAmount) external returns (uint256) {
        minter;
        if (!marketsData[cToken].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (mintGuardianPausedGlobal || mintGuardianPaused[cToken]) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);
        if (isCreditAccount[minter]) return _fail(CREDIT_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION, 0);

        uint256 cap = supplyCaps[cToken];
        if (cap != 0) {
            uint256 total = ICTokenLike(cToken).totalSupply();
            if (total.add(mintAmount) > cap) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);
        }

        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function redeemAllowed(address cToken, address redeemer, uint256 redeemTokens) public returns (uint256) {
        if (!marketsData[cToken].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (!marketsData[cToken].accountMembership[redeemer]) return NO_ERROR;

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(redeemer, cToken, redeemTokens, 0);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function borrowAllowed(address cToken, address borrower, uint256 borrowAmount) public returns (uint256) {
        if (!marketsData[cToken].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (borrowGuardianPausedGlobal || borrowGuardianPaused[cToken]) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);

        if (!marketsData[cToken].accountMembership[borrower]) {
            if (msg.sender != cToken) return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
            uint256 addErr = _addToMarketInternal(cToken, borrower);
            if (addErr != NO_ERROR) return addErr;
        }

        if (_getOraclePrice(cToken) == 0) return _fail(PRICE_ERROR, 0);

        uint256 cap = borrowCaps[cToken];
        if (cap != 0) {
            uint256 totalBorrows = ICTokenLike(cToken).totalBorrows();
            if (totalBorrows.add(borrowAmount) > cap) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);
        }

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(borrower, cToken, 0, borrowAmount);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall != 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function repayBorrowAllowed(address cToken, address payer, address borrower, uint256 repayAmount) external returns (uint256) {
        payer; borrower; repayAmount;
        if (!marketsData[cToken].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function liquidateBorrowAllowed(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 repayAmount
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        liquidator;
        if (!marketsData[cTokenBorrowed].isListed || !marketsData[cTokenCollateral].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (isCreditAccount[borrower]) return _fail(CREDIT_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION, 0);

        (uint256 err, , uint256 shortfall) = getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(borrower, address(0), 0, 0);
        if (err != 0) return _fail(err, 0);
        if (shortfall == 0) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        uint256 borrowBalance = ICTokenLike(cTokenBorrowed).borrowBalanceStored(borrower);
        uint256 maxClose = borrowBalance.mul(closeFactorMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);
        if (repayAmount > maxClose) return _fail(INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY, 0);

        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function seizeAllowed(
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 seizeTokens
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        liquidator; seizeTokens;
        if (seizeGuardianPaused) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);
        if (!marketsData[cTokenCollateral].isListed || !marketsData[cTokenBorrowed].isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (isCreditAccount[borrower]) return _fail(CREDIT_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION, 0);

        if (ICTokenLike(cTokenCollateral).comptroller() != ICTokenLike(cTokenBorrowed).comptroller()) {
            return _fail(UNAUTHORIZED, 0);
        }

        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function transferAllowed(address cToken, address src, address dst, uint256 transferTokens) external returns (uint256) {
        if (transferGuardianPaused) return _fail(MARKET_PAUSED, 0);
        if (isCreditAccount[dst]) return _fail(CREDIT_ACCOUNT_RESTRICTION, 0);

        uint256 allowed = redeemAllowed(cToken, src, transferTokens);
        if (allowed != NO_ERROR) return allowed;
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function mintVerify(address cToken, address minter, uint256 mintAmount, uint256 mintTokens) external pure {
        cToken; minter; mintAmount; mintTokens;
    }

    function redeemVerify(address cToken, address redeemer, uint256 redeemAmount, uint256 redeemTokens) external pure {
        cToken; redeemer; redeemAmount; redeemTokens;
    }

    function borrowVerify(address cToken, address borrower, uint256 borrowAmount) external pure {
        cToken; borrower; borrowAmount;
    }

    function repayBorrowVerify(address cToken, address payer, address borrower, uint256 actualRepayAmount, uint256 borrowerIndex) external pure {
        cToken; payer; borrower; actualRepayAmount; borrowerIndex;
    }

    function seizeVerify(address cTokenCollateral, address cTokenBorrowed, address liquidator, address borrower, uint256 seizeTokens) external pure {
        cTokenCollateral; cTokenBorrowed; liquidator; borrower; seizeTokens;
    }

    function transferVerify(address cToken, address src, address dst, uint256 transferTokens) external pure {
        cToken; src; dst; transferTokens;
    }

    function liquidateBorrowVerify(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        address liquidator,
        address borrower,
        uint256 actualRepayAmount,
        uint256 seizeTokens
    ) external pure {
        cTokenBorrowed; cTokenCollateral; liquidator; borrower; actualRepayAmount; seizeTokens;
    }

    function getAccountLiquidity(address account) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(account, address(0), 0, 0);
    }

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) public view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        return getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(account, cTokenModify, redeemTokens, borrowAmount);
    }

    function liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
        address cTokenBorrowed,
        address cTokenCollateral,
        uint256 actualRepayAmount
    ) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 priceBorrowedMantissa = _getOraclePrice(cTokenBorrowed);
        uint256 priceCollateralMantissa = _getOraclePrice(cTokenCollateral);
        if (priceBorrowedMantissa == 0 || priceCollateralMantissa == 0) {
            return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);
        }

        uint256 exchangeRateMantissa = ICTokenLike(cTokenCollateral).exchangeRateStored();
        if (exchangeRateMantissa == 0) {
            return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);
        }

        uint256 numerator = actualRepayAmount.mul(liquidationIncentiveMantissa).mul(priceBorrowedMantissa);
        uint256 denominator = priceCollateralMantissa.mul(exchangeRateMantissa);
        if (denominator == 0) return (PRICE_ERROR, 0);

        uint256 seizeTokens = numerator.div(denominator);
        return (NO_ERROR, seizeTokens);
    }

    function _calculateAssetLiquidity(
        address account,
        address asset,
        uint256 collateralFactorMantissa,
        bool isModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        (uint256 oErr, uint256 cTokenBalance, uint256 borrowBalance, uint256 exchangeRateMantissa) =
            ICTokenLike(asset).getAccountSnapshot(account);
        if (oErr != 0) return (oErr, 0, 0);

        uint256 oraclePriceMantissa = _getOraclePrice(asset);
        if (oraclePriceMantissa == 0) return (PRICE_ERROR, 0, 0);

        uint256 tokensToDenom = collateralFactorMantissa.mul(exchangeRateMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);
        tokensToDenom = tokensToDenom.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);

        uint256 collateralContribution = cTokenBalance.mul(tokensToDenom).div(EXP_SCALE);
        uint256 borrowContribution = borrowBalance.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE);

        if (isModify) {
            borrowContribution = borrowContribution.add(redeemTokens.mul(tokensToDenom).div(EXP_SCALE));
            borrowContribution = borrowContribution.add(borrowAmount.mul(oraclePriceMantissa).div(EXP_SCALE));
        }

        return (NO_ERROR, collateralContribution, borrowContribution);
    }

    function getHypotheticalAccountLiquidityInternal(
        address account,
        address cTokenModify,
        uint256 redeemTokens,
        uint256 borrowAmount
    ) internal view returns (uint256, uint256, uint256) {
        uint256 sumCollateral = 0;
        uint256 sumBorrowPlusEffects = 0;

        address[] storage assets = accountAssetsList[account];
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            address asset = assets[i];
            Market storage m = marketsData[asset];
            if (!m.isListed) continue;

            (uint256 err, uint256 collateralContribution, uint256 borrowContribution) =
                _calculateAssetLiquidity(
                    account,
                    asset,
                    m.collateralFactorMantissa,
                    asset == cTokenModify,
                    redeemTokens,
                    borrowAmount
                );

            if (err != NO_ERROR) return (err, 0, 0);

            sumCollateral = sumCollateral.add(collateralContribution);
            sumBorrowPlusEffects = sumBorrowPlusEffects.add(borrowContribution);
        }

        if (isCreditAccount[account]) {
            uint256 limit = creditLimits[account];
            if (limit > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
                return (NO_ERROR, limit.sub(sumBorrowPlusEffects), 0);
            }
            return (NO_ERROR, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects.sub(limit));
        }

        if (sumCollateral > sumBorrowPlusEffects) {
            return (NO_ERROR, sumCollateral.sub(sumBorrowPlusEffects), 0);
        }
        return (NO_ERROR, 0, sumBorrowPlusEffects.sub(sumCollateral));
    }

    function _addToMarketInternal(address cToken, address account) internal returns (uint256) {
        Market storage m = marketsData[cToken];
        if (!m.isListed) return _fail(MARKET_NOT_LISTED, 0);
        if (m.accountMembership[account]) return NO_ERROR;
        if (accountAssetsList[account].length >= maxAssets) return _fail(TOO_MANY_ASSETS, 0);

        m.accountMembership[account] = true;
        accountAssetsList[account].push(cToken);
        emit MarketEntered(cToken, account);
        return NO_ERROR;
    }

    function _removeAsset(address account, address cToken) internal {
        uint256 len = accountAssetsList[account].length;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            if (accountAssetsList[account][i] == cToken) {
                accountAssetsList[account][i] = accountAssetsList[account][len - 1];
                accountAssetsList[account].length = len - 1;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    function _getOraclePrice(address cToken) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (oracle == address(0)) return 0;
        return IPriceOracleLike(oracle).getUnderlyingPrice(cToken);
    }

    function _fail(uint256 error, uint256 info) internal returns (uint256) {
        emit Failure(error, info, 0);
        return error;
    }

    function() external {
        if (msg.sig == bytes4(0x007e3dd2)) {
            assembly {
                mstore(0x00, 1)
                return(0x00, 0x20)
            }
        }
        revert("unknown selector");
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.6.12;
pragma experimental ABIEncoderV2;

library SafeMath {
    function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        uint256 c = a + b;
        require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b <= a, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
        return a - b;
    }

    function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        if (a == 0) return 0;
        uint256 c = a * b;
        require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
        return c;
    }

    function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(b > 0, "SafeMath: division by zero");
        return a / b;
    }
}

interface IFlashLoanReceiver {
    function executeOperation(
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        uint256[] calldata premiums,
        address initiator,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (bool);
}

contract LendingPool {
    using SafeMath for uint256;

    struct ReserveLimits {
        uint256 l1;
        uint256 l2;
        uint256 l3;
        uint256 l4;
        uint256 l5;
        uint256 l6;
    }

    struct ReserveData {
        uint256 configuration;
        uint128 liquidityIndex;
        uint128 variableBorrowIndex;
        uint128 currentLiquidityRate;
        uint128 currentVariableBorrowRate;
        uint128 currentStableBorrowRate;
        uint40 lastUpdateTimestamp;
        address aTokenAddress;
        address stableDebtTokenAddress;
        address variableDebtTokenAddress;
        address interestRateStrategyAddress;
        uint8 id;
        bool initialized;
        ReserveLimits limits;
    }

    mapping(address => ReserveData) internal _reserves;
    address[] internal _reservesList;

    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal _balances;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal _stableDebts;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) internal _variableDebts;
    mapping(address => mapping(address => bool)) internal _useAsCollateral;

    mapping(address => uint256) internal _userConfigurationData;
    mapping(address => bool) internal _blacklisted;

    address internal _addressesProvider;
    bool internal _paused;
    bool internal _initialized;

    uint256 public FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL;
    uint256 public MAX_STABLE_RATE_BORROW_SIZE_PERCENT;
    uint256 public MAX_NUMBER_RESERVES;
    uint256 public constant LENDINGPOOL_REVISION = 1;

    event Deposit(address indexed reserve, address indexed user, address indexed onBehalfOf, uint256 amount, uint16 referral);
    event Withdraw(address indexed reserve, address indexed user, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    event Borrow(address indexed reserve, address indexed user, address indexed onBehalfOf, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, uint256 borrowRate, uint16 referral);
    event Repay(address indexed reserve, address indexed user, address indexed repayer, uint256 amount);
    event FlashLoan(address indexed target, address indexed initiator, address indexed asset, uint256 amount, uint256 premium, uint16 referralCode);
    event Swap(address indexed reserve, address indexed user, uint256 rateMode);
    event RebalanceStableBorrowRate(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);
    event ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);
    event ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(address indexed reserve, address indexed user);
    event ReserveDataUpdated(address indexed reserve, uint256 liquidityRate, uint256 stableBorrowRate, uint256 variableBorrowRate, uint256 liquidityIndex, uint256 variableBorrowIndex);
    event Blacklist(address indexed user);
    event Paused();
    event Unpaused();

    modifier onlyConfigurator() {
        require(msg.sender == _getConfigurator(), "CALLER_NOT_POOL_CONFIGURATOR");
        _;
    }

    modifier whenNotPaused() {
        require(!_paused, "LP_IS_PAUSED");
        _;
    }

    function initialize(address provider) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Contract instance has already been initialized");
        require(provider != address(0) && _isContract(provider), "Address: call to non-contract");

        _addressesProvider = provider;
        MAX_STABLE_RATE_BORROW_SIZE_PERCENT = 2500;
        FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL = 9;
        MAX_NUMBER_RESERVES = 128;
        _paused = false;
        _initialized = true;
    }

    function getAddressesProvider() external view returns (address) {
        return _addressesProvider;
    }

    function paused() external view returns (bool) {
        return _paused;
    }

    function isBlacklisted(address user) external view returns (bool) {
        return _blacklisted[user];
    }

    function getConfiguration(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _reserves[asset].configuration;
    }

    function getUserConfiguration(address user) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _userConfigurationData[user];
    }

    function getReserveLimits(address asset)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256
        )
    {
        ReserveLimits storage lim = _reserves[asset].limits;
        return (lim.l1, lim.l2, lim.l3, lim.l4, lim.l5, lim.l6);
    }

    function getReserveData(address asset)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 configuration,
            uint128 liquidityIndex,
            uint128 variableBorrowIndex,
            uint128 currentLiquidityRate,
            uint128 currentVariableBorrowRate,
            uint128 currentStableBorrowRate,
            uint40 lastUpdateTimestamp,
            address aTokenAddress,
            address stableDebtTokenAddress,
            address variableDebtTokenAddress,
            address interestRateStrategyAddress,
            uint8 id
        )
    {
        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        return (
            r.configuration,
            r.liquidityIndex,
            r.variableBorrowIndex,
            r.currentLiquidityRate,
            r.currentVariableBorrowRate,
            r.currentStableBorrowRate,
            r.lastUpdateTimestamp,
            r.aTokenAddress,
            r.stableDebtTokenAddress,
            r.variableDebtTokenAddress,
            r.interestRateStrategyAddress,
            r.id
        );
    }

    function getReserveNormalizedIncome(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 idx = uint256(_reserves[asset].liquidityIndex);
        return idx == 0 ? 1e27 : idx;
    }

    function getReserveNormalizedVariableDebt(address asset) external view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 idx = uint256(_reserves[asset].variableBorrowIndex);
        return idx == 0 ? 1e27 : idx;
    }

    function getReservesList() external view returns (address[] memory) {
        return _reservesList;
    }

    function getUserAccountData(address user)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256
        )
    {
        uint256 collateral;
        uint256 debt;
        uint256 len = _reservesList.length;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            (uint256 c, uint256 d) = _getUserAssetDataInEth(user, _reservesList[i]);
            collateral = collateral.add(c);
            debt = debt.add(d);
        }

        uint256 currentLiquidationThreshold = 8000;
        uint256 ltv = 7500;
        uint256 availableBorrowsETH = collateral > debt ? collateral.sub(debt) : 0;
        uint256 healthFactor = debt == 0 ? uint256(-1) : collateral.mul(1e18).div(debt);

        return (
            collateral,
            debt,
            availableBorrowsETH,
            currentLiquidationThreshold,
            ltv,
            healthFactor
        );
    }

    function initReserve(
        address asset,
        address aToken,
        address stableDebtToken,
        address variableDebtToken,
        address interestRateStrategyAddress
    ) external onlyConfigurator {
        require(asset != address(0), "INVALID_ASSET");
        require(!_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_ALREADY_INITIALIZED");
        require(_reservesList.length < MAX_NUMBER_RESERVES, "NO_MORE_RESERVES_ALLOWED");
        require(_reservesList.length < 256, "MAX_ID_EXCEEDED");

        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        r.aTokenAddress = aToken;
        r.stableDebtTokenAddress = stableDebtToken;
        r.variableDebtTokenAddress = variableDebtToken;
        r.interestRateStrategyAddress = interestRateStrategyAddress;
        r.liquidityIndex = uint128(1e27);
        r.variableBorrowIndex = uint128(1e27);
        r.lastUpdateTimestamp = uint40(block.timestamp);
        r.id = uint8(_reservesList.length);
        r.initialized = true;

        _reservesList.push(asset);
        _emitReserveDataUpdated(asset);
    }

    function setConfiguration(address asset, uint256 configuration) external onlyConfigurator {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        _reserves[asset].configuration = configuration;
        _touchReserve(asset);
    }

    function setReserveInterestRateStrategyAddress(address asset, address rateStrategyAddress) external onlyConfigurator {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        _reserves[asset].interestRateStrategyAddress = rateStrategyAddress;
        _touchReserve(asset);
    }

    function setLimits(address asset, ReserveLimits calldata limits) external onlyConfigurator {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        ReserveLimits storage lim = _reserves[asset].limits;
        lim.l1 = limits.l1;
        lim.l2 = limits.l2;
        lim.l3 = limits.l3;
        lim.l4 = limits.l4;
        lim.l5 = limits.l5;
        lim.l6 = limits.l6;
    }

    function setPause(bool val) external onlyConfigurator {
        _paused = val;
        if (val) emit Paused();
        else emit Unpaused();
    }

    function deposit(address asset, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16 referralCode) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(amount > 0, "INVALID_AMOUNT");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(onBehalfOf);

        _safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        _balances[onBehalfOf][asset] = _balances[onBehalfOf][asset].add(amount);

        if (!_useAsCollateral[onBehalfOf][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(onBehalfOf, asset, true);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, onBehalfOf);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Deposit(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amount, referralCode);
    }

    function withdraw(address asset, uint256 amount, address to) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(to);

        uint256 userBal = _balances[msg.sender][asset];
        uint256 amountToWithdraw = amount == uint256(-1) ? userBal : amount;
        require(amountToWithdraw <= userBal, "NOT_ENOUGH_BALANCE");

        _balances[msg.sender][asset] = userBal.sub(amountToWithdraw);
        _safeTransfer(asset, to, amountToWithdraw);

        if (_balances[msg.sender][asset] == 0 && _useAsCollateral[msg.sender][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(msg.sender, asset, false);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, msg.sender);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Withdraw(asset, msg.sender, to, amountToWithdraw);
        return amountToWithdraw;
    }

    function borrow(
        address asset,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 interestRateMode,
        uint16 referralCode,
        address onBehalfOf
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(amount > 0, "INVALID_AMOUNT");
        require(interestRateMode == 1 || interestRateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(onBehalfOf);

        if (interestRateMode == 1) {
            _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(amount);
        } else {
            _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(amount);
        }

        _setUserBorrowing(onBehalfOf, asset, true);
        _safeTransfer(asset, msg.sender, amount);

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Borrow(asset, msg.sender, onBehalfOf, amount, interestRateMode, 0, referralCode);
    }

    function repay(address asset, uint256 amount, uint256 rateMode, address onBehalfOf) external whenNotPaused returns (uint256) {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(rateMode == 1 || rateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);
        _requireNotBlacklisted(onBehalfOf);

        uint256 debt = rateMode == 1 ? _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] : _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset];
        require(debt > 0, "NO_DEBT");

        uint256 payback = amount == uint256(-1) ? debt : _min(amount, debt);
        _safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, address(this), payback);

        if (rateMode == 1) {
            _stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = debt.sub(payback);
        } else {
            _variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset] = debt.sub(payback);
        }

        if (_stableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset].add(_variableDebts[onBehalfOf][asset]) == 0) {
            _setUserBorrowing(onBehalfOf, asset, false);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Repay(asset, onBehalfOf, msg.sender, payback);
        return payback;
    }

    function swapBorrowRateMode(address asset, uint256 rateMode) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(rateMode == 1 || rateMode == 2, "INVALID_RATE_MODE");

        uint256 stableDebt = _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset];
        uint256 variableDebt = _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset];
        require(stableDebt > 0 || variableDebt > 0, "NO_DEBT");

        if (rateMode == 1) {
            require(variableDebt > 0, "NO_VARIABLE_DEBT");
            _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = 0;
            _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset].add(variableDebt);
        } else {
            require(stableDebt > 0, "NO_STABLE_DEBT");
            _stableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = 0;
            _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset] = _variableDebts[msg.sender][asset].add(stableDebt);
        }

        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit Swap(asset, msg.sender, rateMode);
    }

    function setUserUseReserveAsCollateral(address asset, bool useAsCollateral) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        _requireNotBlacklisted(msg.sender);

        if (useAsCollateral) {
            require(_balances[msg.sender][asset] > 0, "NO_DEPOSIT");
        }

        bool current = _useAsCollateral[msg.sender][asset];
        if (current == useAsCollateral) return;

        _setUserCollateral(msg.sender, asset, useAsCollateral);
        if (useAsCollateral) emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, msg.sender);
        else emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, msg.sender);
    }

    function rebalanceStableBorrowRate(address asset, address user) external whenNotPaused {
        require(_reserves[asset].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(_stableDebts[user][asset] > 0, "NO_STABLE_DEBT");
        _touchReserve(asset);
        emit RebalanceStableBorrowRate(asset, user);
    }

    function finalizeTransfer(
        address asset,
        address from,
        address to,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 balanceFromBefore,
        uint256 balanceToBefore
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        require(r.initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
        require(msg.sender == r.aTokenAddress, "CALLER_MUST_BE_ATOKEN");

        if (from != address(0)) {
            require(_balances[from][asset] == balanceFromBefore, "FROM_BALANCE_MISMATCH");
        }
        if (to != address(0)) {
            require(_balances[to][asset] == balanceToBefore, "TO_BALANCE_MISMATCH");
        }

        if (from != to && amount > 0) {
            if (from != address(0)) {
                _balances[from][asset] = _balances[from][asset].sub(amount);
            }
            if (to != address(0)) {
                _balances[to][asset] = _balances[to][asset].add(amount);
            }
        }

        if (from != address(0) && _balances[from][asset] == 0 && _useAsCollateral[from][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(from, asset, false);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralDisabled(asset, from);
        }

        if (to != address(0) && _balances[to][asset] > 0 && !_useAsCollateral[to][asset]) {
            _setUserCollateral(to, asset, true);
            emit ReserveUsedAsCollateralEnabled(asset, to);
        }
    }

    function flashLoan(
        address receiverAddress,
        address[] calldata assets,
        uint256[] calldata amounts,
        bytes calldata params,
        uint16 referralCode
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        require(receiverAddress != address(0), "INVALID_RECEIVER");
        require(assets.length == amounts.length, "INCONSISTENT_PARAMS");

        uint256[] memory premiums = new uint256[](assets.length);

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            require(_reserves[assets[i]].initialized, "RESERVE_NOT_INITIALIZED");
            premiums[i] = amounts[i].mul(FLASHLOAN_PREMIUM_TOTAL).div(10000);
            _safeTransfer(assets[i], receiverAddress, amounts[i]);
        }

        bool ok = IFlashLoanReceiver(receiverAddress).executeOperation(assets, amounts, premiums, msg.sender, params);
        require(ok, "INVALID_FLASHLOAN_EXECUTOR_RETURN");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < assets.length; i++) {
            uint256 amountPlusPremium = amounts[i].add(premiums[i]);
            _safeTransferFrom(assets[i], receiverAddress, address(this), amountPlusPremium);
            emit FlashLoan(receiverAddress, msg.sender, assets[i], amounts[i], premiums[i], referralCode);
            _touchReserve(assets[i]);
        }
    }

    function liquidationCall(
        address collateralAsset,
        address debtAsset,
        address user,
        uint256 debtToCover,
        bool receiveAToken
    ) external whenNotPaused {
        _requireNotBlacklisted(user);

        address collateralManager = _getCollateralManager();
        require(collateralManager != address(0) && _isContract(collateralManager), "Address: call to non-contract");

        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = collateralManager.delegatecall(
            abi.encodeWithSelector(
                bytes4(0x00a718a9),
                collateralAsset,
                debtAsset,
                user,
                debtToCover,
                receiveAToken
            )
        );

        if (!success) {
            if (returndata.length > 0) {
                assembly {
                    revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
                }
            }
            revert("LIQUIDATION_CALL_FAILED");
        }
    }

    function repayAllAndBlacklist(address user) external whenNotPaused {
        require(user != address(0), "INVALID_USER");
        address cfg = _getConfigurator();
        require(msg.sender == user || msg.sender == cfg, "NOT_AUTHORIZED");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < _reservesList.length; i++) {
            address asset = _reservesList[i];
            _stableDebts[user][asset] = 0;
            _variableDebts[user][asset] = 0;
            _setUserBorrowing(user, asset, false);
        }

        _blacklisted[user] = true;
        emit Blacklist(user);
    }

    function _setUserCollateral(address user, address asset, bool value) internal {
        _useAsCollateral[user][asset] = value;
        uint256 bit = uint256(_reserves[asset].id).mul(2);
        _setUserConfigBit(user, bit, value);
    }

    function _setUserBorrowing(address user, address asset, bool value) internal {
        uint256 bit = uint256(_reserves[asset].id).mul(2).add(1);
        _setUserConfigBit(user, bit, value);
    }

    function _setUserConfigBit(address user, uint256 bit, bool value) internal {
        uint256 mask = uint256(1) << bit;
        if (value) {
            _userConfigurationData[user] = _userConfigurationData[user] | mask;
        } else {
            _userConfigurationData[user] = _userConfigurationData[user] & (~mask);
        }
    }

    function _touchReserve(address asset) internal {
        _reserves[asset].lastUpdateTimestamp = uint40(block.timestamp);
        _emitReserveDataUpdated(asset);
    }

    function _emitReserveDataUpdated(address asset) internal {
        ReserveData storage r = _reserves[asset];
        emit ReserveDataUpdated(
            asset,
            uint256(r.currentLiquidityRate),
            uint256(r.currentStableBorrowRate),
            uint256(r.currentVariableBorrowRate),
            uint256(r.liquidityIndex),
            uint256(r.variableBorrowIndex)
        );
    }

    function _getUserAssetDataInEth(address user, address asset) internal view returns (uint256 collateralEth, uint256 debtEth) {
        uint256 price = _getAssetPrice(asset);

        uint256 bal = _balances[user][asset];
        if (bal > 0 && _useAsCollateral[user][asset]) {
            collateralEth = bal.mul(price).div(1e18);
        }

        uint256 totalDebt = _stableDebts[user][asset].add(_variableDebts[user][asset]);
        if (totalDebt > 0) {
            debtEth = totalDebt.mul(price).div(1e18);
        }
    }

    function _getConfigurator() internal view returns (address cfg) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x85c858b1)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        cfg = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _getCollateralManager() internal view returns (address cm) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return address(0);
        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x712d9171)));
        if (!ok || data.length < 32) return address(0);
        cm = abi.decode(data, (address));
    }

    function _getAssetPrice(address asset) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_addressesProvider == address(0)) return 1e18;

        (bool okProvider, bytes memory dataProvider) = _addressesProvider.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xfca513a8)));
        if (!okProvider || dataProvider.length < 32) return 1e18;

        address oracle = abi.decode(dataProvider, (address));
        if (oracle == address(0) || !_isContract(oracle)) return 1e18;

        (bool okOracle, bytes memory dataOracle) = oracle.staticcall(abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xb3596f07), asset));
        if (!okOracle || dataOracle.length < 32) return 1e18;

        return abi.decode(dataOracle, (uint256));
    }

    function _safeTransfer(address token, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0xa9059cbb), to, value));
    }

    function _safeTransferFrom(address token, address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {
        _callOptionalReturn(token, abi.encodeWithSelector(bytes4(0x23b872dd), from, to, value));
    }

    function _callOptionalReturn(address token, bytes memory data) internal {
        require(_isContract(token), "Address: call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = token.call(data);
        require(success, "SafeERC20: low-level call failed");
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            require(abi.decode(returndata, (bool)), "SafeERC20: ERC20 operation did not succeed");
        }
    }

    function _requireNotBlacklisted(address user) internal view {
        require(!_blacklisted[user], "BLACKLISTED");
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        uint256 size;
        assembly {
            size := extcodesize(account)
        }
        return size > 0;
    }

    function _min(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return a < b ? a : b;
    }
}

        _dequeue(key, orderId);

                _safeTransfer(o.token, o.user, remaining);
            } else {

    function setFeePercentage(uint256 newFee) external onlyOwner {

        if (amount == 0) revert("No fees to withdraw");

        _transferOwnership(address(0));

    function getReserves(address token) public view returns (uint256 reserveToken, uint256 reserveWeth) {
        address routerAddr = _routerFromRegistry();
        require(routerAddr != address(0), "Router not set");

        address factoryAddr = _staticAddress(routerAddr, bytes4(0xc45a0155));
        require(factoryAddr != address(0), "Factory not set");

        address weth = _staticAddress(factoryAddr, bytes4(0xad5c4648));
        require(weth != address(0), "WETH not set");

        address pair = _pair(factoryAddr, token, weth);
        require(pair != address(0), "Market maker pool not set");

        (uint112 r0, uint112 r1, ) = IPairLike(pair).getReserves();
        address t0 = IPairLike(pair).token0();

        if (t0 == token) {
            reserveToken = uint256(r0);
            reserveWeth = uint256(r1);
        } else {
            reserveToken = uint256(r1);
            reserveWeth = uint256(r0);
        }
    }

    function getMarketPrice(address token) public view returns (uint256) {
        (uint256 reserveToken, uint256 reserveWeth) = getReserves(token);
        require(reserveToken > 0 && reserveWeth > 0, "Insufficient liquidity");
        return (reserveWeth * 1e18) / reserveToken;
    }

    function isPriceWithinDeviation(address token, uint256 executionPrice) public view returns (bool) {
        uint256 marketPrice = getMarketPrice(token);
        uint256 d = _absDiff(executionPrice, marketPrice);
        return (d * DIVISOR) / marketPrice <= _maxPriceDeviation;
    }

    function _placeOrder(
        uint256 sideRaw,
        uint256 kindRaw,
        address token,
        uint256 price,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 ttl
    ) internal returns (uint256 orderId) {
        require(sideRaw < 2 && kindRaw < 2, "Invalid order types");
        require(token != address(0), "Invalid token");
        require(amount > 0, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(price > 0, "Invalid price range");
        require(ttl > 0, "TTL must be greater than 0");
        require(ttl <= _maxOrderTtl, "TTL too long");
        require(amount >= _minOrderSize, "Amount must be greater than 0");
        require(amount <= _maxOrderSize, "Order too large");
        require(!_isBlockedToken(token), "Blocked token");

        uint8 side = uint8(sideRaw);
        uint8 kind = uint8(kindRaw);

        if (side == 0) {
            uint256 requiredQuote = (amount * price) / 1e18;
            require(msg.value >= requiredQuote, "Insufficient ETH sent");
            if (msg.value > requiredQuote) {
                (bool refundOk, ) = msg.sender.call{value: msg.value - requiredQuote}("");
                require(refundOk, "ETH transfer to seller failed");
            }
        } else {
            require(msg.value == 0, "ETH not accepted");
            _safeTransferFrom(token, msg.sender, address(this), amount);
        }

        orderId = ++_nextOrderId;
        uint256 expiry = block.timestamp + ttl;

        _orders[orderId] = Order({
            id: orderId,
            user: msg.sender,
            side: side,
            kind: kind,
            token: token,
            price: price,
            amount: amount,
            filled: 0,
            expiry: expiry,
            status: STATUS_ACTIVE

        bytes22 key = _marketKey(token, side, kind);
        _enqueue(key, orderId);

        emit OrderPlaced(orderId, msg.sender, token, side, kind, price, amount, expiry);
    }

    function _executeOrder(uint256 orderId) internal {
        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.user == address(0)) revert("Order not found");
        uint256 remaining = getRemainingAmount(orderId);
        if (remaining == 0) return;
        uint256 px = getMarketPrice(o.token);
        _executeOrderPartial(orderId, remaining, px);
    }

    function _executeOrderPartial(uint256 orderId, uint256 fillAmount, uint256 executionPrice) internal {
        if (fillAmount == 0) revert("Fill amount must be greater than 0");

        Order storage o = _orders[orderId];
        if (o.user == address(0)) revert("Order not found");
        if (o.status != STATUS_ACTIVE) revert("Order not active");

        bytes22 key = _marketKey(o.token, o.side, o.kind);

        if (block.timestamp > o.expiry) {
            o.status = STATUS_EXPIRED;
            _dequeue(key, orderId);
            emit OrderExpired(orderId);
            return;
        }

        uint256 remaining = o.amount - o.filled;
        if (fillAmount > remaining) fillAmount = remaining;

        if (executionPrice == 0) executionPrice = getMarketPrice(o.token);
        if (!isPriceWithinDeviation(o.token, executionPrice)) {
            revert("Execution price deviates too much from market price");
        }

        if (o.kind == 0) {
            if (o.side == 0) require(executionPrice <= o.price, "Execution price exceeds buyer's max price");
            else require(executionPrice >= o.price, "Execution price below seller's min price");
        }

        o.filled += fillAmount;

        uint256 quoteAmount = (fillAmount * executionPrice) / 1e18;
        uint256 fee = (quoteAmount * _feePercentage) / DIVISOR;
        _totalFeesCollected += fee;

        if (o.filled >= o.amount) {
            o.status = STATUS_FILLED;
            _dequeue(key, orderId);
        }

        emit OrderFulfilled(orderId, fillAmount);
    }

    function _getActiveOrders(address token, uint8 side, uint8 kind) internal view returns (uint256[] memory ids) {
        bytes22 key = _marketKey(token, side, kind);
        uint256 count = _activeCountByKey(key);
        ids = new uint256[](count);

        uint256 idx;
        uint256 cur = _queueHead[key];
        while (cur != 0) {
            Order storage o = _orders[cur];
            if (o.status == STATUS_ACTIVE && block.timestamp <= o.expiry) {
                ids[idx++] = cur;
            }
            cur = _nextInQueue[key][cur];
        }
    }

    function _activeCountByKey(bytes22 key) internal view returns (uint256 count) {
        uint256 cur = _queueHead[key];
        while (cur != 0) {
            Order storage o = _orders[cur];
            if (o.status == STATUS_ACTIVE && block.timestamp <= o.expiry) {
                count++;
            }
            cur = _nextInQueue[key][cur];
        }
    }

    function _enqueue(bytes22 key, uint256 orderId) internal {
        uint256 tail = _queueTail[key];
        if (tail == 0) {
            _queueHead[key] = orderId;
            _queueTail[key] = orderId;
        } else {
            _nextInQueue[key][tail] = orderId;
            _prevInQueue[key][orderId] = tail;
            _queueTail[key] = orderId;

    }

    function _dequeue(bytes22 key, uint256 orderId) internal {
        uint256 prev = _prevInQueue[key][orderId];
        uint256 next = _nextInQueue[key][orderId];

        if (prev == 0) _queueHead[key] = next;
        else _nextInQueue[key][prev] = next;

        if (next == 0) _queueTail[key] = prev;
        else _prevInQueue[key][next] = prev;

        delete _prevInQueue[key][orderId];
        delete _nextInQueue[key][orderId];

        if (_marketActiveCount[key] > 0) {
            _marketActiveCount[key] -= 1;
        }
    }

        if (account == _owner) return true;
        if (_gradientRegistry == address(0)) return false;

        (bool ok, bytes memory data) = _gradientRegistry.staticcall(

        }

        uint256 delay = _timelockContract.getMinDelay();
        bytes32 operationId = _timelockContract.hashOperationBatch(targets, values, calldatas, bytes32(0), descriptionHash);
        _timelockContract.scheduleBatch(targets, values, calldatas, bytes32(0), descriptionHash, delay);

        _timelockIds[proposalId] = operationId;
        emit ProposalQueued(proposalId, block.timestamp + delay);

        return proposalId;
    }

    function execute(
        address[] calldata targets,
        uint256[] calldata values,
        bytes[] calldata calldatas,
        bytes32 descriptionHash
    ) external payable returns (uint256) {
        uint256 proposalId = hashProposal(targets, values, calldatas, descriptionHash);
        ProposalState st = state(proposalId);
        require(st == ProposalState.Succeeded || st == ProposalState.Queued, "Governor: proposal not successful");

        _proposals[proposalId].executed = true;
        emit ProposalExecuted(proposalId);

        _requireContract(address(_timelockContract), "Address: call to non-contract");
        _timelockContract.executeBatch{value: msg.value}(targets, values, calldatas, bytes32(0), descriptionHash);

        return proposalId;
    }

    function getVotes(address account, uint256 timepoint) public view returns (uint256) {
        return getVotesWithParams(account, timepoint, "");
    }

    function getVotesWithParams(address account, uint256 timepoint, bytes memory) public view returns (uint256) {
        _requireContract(address(_tokenContract), "Address: call to non-contract");
        return _tokenContract.getPastVotes(account, timepoint);
    }

    function proposalVotes(uint256 proposalId)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 againstVotes, uint256 forVotes, uint256 abstainVotes)
    {
        ProposalVote storage pv = _proposalVotes[proposalId];
        return (pv.againstVotes, pv.forVotes, pv.abstainVotes);
    }

    function hasVoted(uint256 proposalId, address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _proposalVotes[proposalId].hasVoted[account];
    }

    function castVote(uint256 proposalId, uint8 support) external returns (uint256) {
        return _castVote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, "", "");
    }

    function castVoteWithReason(uint256 proposalId, uint8 support, string calldata reason) external returns (uint256) {
        return _castVote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, reason, "");
    }

    function castVoteWithReasonAndParams(
        uint256 proposalId,
        uint8 support,
        string calldata reason,
        bytes calldata params
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        return _castVote(proposalId, msg.sender, support, reason, params);
    }

    function castVoteBySig(uint256 proposalId, uint8 support, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) external returns (uint256) {
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(abi.encode(BALLOT_TYPEHASH, proposalId, support));
        address voter = _recover(_hashTypedDataV4(structHash), v, r, s);
        return _castVote(proposalId, voter, support, "", "");
    }

    function castVoteWithReasonAndParamsBySig(
        uint256 proposalId,
        uint8 support,
        string calldata reason,
        bytes calldata params,
        uint8 v,
        bytes32 r,
        bytes32 s
    ) external returns (uint256) {
        bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                EXTENDED_BALLOT_TYPEHASH,
                proposalId,
                support,
                keccak256(bytes(reason)),
                keccak256(params)
            )
        );
        address voter = _recover(_hashTypedDataV4(structHash), v, r, s);
        return _castVote(proposalId, voter, support, reason, params);
    }

    function setVotingDelay(uint256 newVotingDelay) external onlyGovernance {
        emit VotingDelaySet(_votingDelayValue, newVotingDelay);
        _votingDelayValue = newVotingDelay;
    }

    function setVotingPeriod(uint256 newVotingPeriod) external onlyGovernance {
        require(newVotingPeriod > 0, "GovernorSettings: voting period too low");
        emit VotingPeriodSet(_votingPeriodValue, newVotingPeriod);
        _votingPeriodValue = newVotingPeriod;
    }

    function setProposalThreshold(uint256 newProposalThreshold) external onlyGovernance {
        emit ProposalThresholdSet(_proposalThresholdValue, newProposalThreshold);
        _proposalThresholdValue = newProposalThreshold;
    }

    function updateTimelock(address newTimelock) external onlyGovernance {
        emit TimelockChange(address(_timelockContract), newTimelock);
        _timelockContract = ITimelockLike(newTimelock);
    }

    function relay(address target, uint256 value, bytes calldata data) external onlyGovernance {
        require(address(this).balance >= value, "Address: insufficient balance for call");
        require(target.code.length > 0, "Address: call to non-contract");

        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.call{value: value}(data);
        if (!success) {
            _revertWithData(returndata, "Address: low-level call failed");
        }
    }

    function onERC721Received(address, address, uint256, bytes calldata) external pure override returns (bytes4) {
        return this.onERC721Received.selector;
    }

    function onERC1155Received(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata)
        external
        pure
        override
        returns (bytes4)
    {
        return this.onERC1155Received.selector;
    }

    function onERC1155BatchReceived(address, address, uint256[] calldata, uint256[] calldata, bytes calldata)
        external
        pure
        override
        returns (bytes4)
    {
        return this.onERC1155BatchReceived.selector;
    }

    function supportsInterface(bytes4 interfaceId) public pure override returns (bool) {
        return
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC165 ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_GOVERNOR ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_GOVERNOR_EXT ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_GOVERNOR_EXTRA ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC1155_RECEIVER ||
            interfaceId == _INTERFACE_ID_ERC721_RECEIVER;
    }

    function _castVote(
        uint256 proposalId,
        address account,
        uint8 support,
        string memory reason,
        bytes memory params
    ) internal returns (uint256) {
        require(state(proposalId) == ProposalState.Active, "Governor: vote not currently active");
        require(support <= 2, "GovernorVotingSimple: invalid value for enum VoteType");

        ProposalVote storage pv = _proposalVotes[proposalId];
        require(!pv.hasVoted[account], "GovernorVotingSimple: vote already cast");
        pv.hasVoted[account] = true;

        uint256 weight = getVotesWithParams(account, proposalSnapshot(proposalId), params);

        if (support == 0) {
            pv.againstVotes += weight;
        } else if (support == 1) {
            pv.forVotes += weight;
        } else {
            pv.abstainVotes += weight;
        }

        if (params.length == 0) {
            emit VoteCast(account, proposalId, support, weight, reason);
        } else {
            emit VoteCastWithParams(account, proposalId, support, weight, reason, params);
        }

        return weight;
    }

    function _quorumReached(uint256 proposalId) internal view returns (bool) {
        ProposalVote storage pv = _proposalVotes[proposalId];
        return (pv.forVotes + pv.abstainVotes) >= quorum(proposalSnapshot(proposalId));
    }

    function _voteSucceeded(uint256 proposalId) internal view returns (bool) {
        ProposalVote storage pv = _proposalVotes[proposalId];
        return pv.forVotes > pv.againstVotes;
    }

    function _executor() internal view returns (address) {
        return address(_timelockContract);
    }

    function _toUint64(uint256 value) internal pure returns (uint64) {
        require(value <= type(uint64).max, "SafeCast: value doesn't fit in 64 bits");
        return uint64(value);
    }

    function _domainSeparatorV4() internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(
            abi.encode(
                _EIP712_DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
                keccak256(bytes(_governorName)),
                keccak256(bytes("1")),
                block.chainid,
                address(this)
            )
        );
    }

    function _hashTypedDataV4(bytes32 structHash) internal view returns (bytes32) {
        return keccak256(abi.encodePacked(bytes2(0x1901), _domainSeparatorV4(), structHash));
    }

    function _recover(bytes32 digest, uint8 v, bytes32 r, bytes32 s) internal pure returns (address) {
        require(uint256(s) <= _SECP256K1_N_DIV_2, "ECDSA: invalid signature 's' value");
        require(v == 27 || v == 28, "ECDSA: invalid signature 'v' value");

        address signer = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
        require(signer != address(0), "ECDSA: invalid signature");
        return signer;
    }

    function _requireContract(address target, string memory errorMessage) internal view {
        require(target.code.length > 0, errorMessage);
    }

    function _revertWithData(bytes memory returndata, string memory fallbackMessage) internal pure {
        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert(fallbackMessage);
    }
}
